jobs.title: Application Developer
jobs.description: **Application Developer** ========================= * OFFICE OF THE MAYOR Posted on 09/15/2026 * Full\-time Location MANHATTAN * No exam required Department A/S Information Technology Salary range: $100,000\.00 – $135,000\.00 Save **Job Description** ------------------- The Agency You’ll Join: The New York City Mayor’s Office is responsible for overseeing city services throughout the five boroughs, coordinating public agencies and departments, and managing public property. The administration is leading the fight in making the city more affordable, reducing inequality, improving public safety, ensuring delivery of efficient and effective services, and working to make New York City’s economy stronger. We value leadership, transparency, fairness, and efficiency as we actively seek diverse talents from various sectors to join our team. For current job opportunities, visit our careers page. The Team You’ll Work With: The Mayor’s Office Information Technology Department collaborates with other city agencies to implement IT policy, procedures, and develop secure tools/applications for use by multiple agencies. IT also partners with other departments in the Mayor’s Office to develop tools and applications that streamline processes, measure performance/metrics, and increase productivity. The Problems You’ll Solve: * Design, develop, and maintain efficient, scalable, and secure web applications, APIs, and enterprise solutions using the .NET framework, modern web technologies, and the Microsoft Azure cloud stack. * Translate complex business requirements into actionable technical designs, scalable solutions, and high\-level technical blueprints in collaboration with cross\-functional teams and business analysts. * Design and implement application architectures, integrations, and data solutions that seamlessly connect enterprise systems, databases, third\-party tools, RESTful APIs, cloud services, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM while maintaining data integrity and accessibility. * Provide ongoing support, maintenance, monitoring, and enhancement of critical citywide applications, ensuring system stability, reliability, security, and uninterrupted service for users. * Diagnose and resolve application defects, production issues, system malfunctions, and performance problems across the technology stack. Optimize applications and code to meet business requirements and service\-level expectations. * Develop and maintain automated unit and integration tests, participate in quality assurance activities, conduct code reviews, and ensure applications meet established standards for reliability, maintainability, performance, and functionality. * Collaborate with the City's Cyber Command and relevant IT teams to ensure applications meet security accreditation, OTI compliance, data protection, and enterprise technology standards. Apply secure development practices throughout the application lifecycle. * Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, system roadmaps, source code repositories, and deployment procedures. Gather and incorporate user feedback, provide training and application support to business teams, research emerging technologies, and recommend innovative solutions that improve operational efficiency. About You: * You possess strong organizational, communication, customer service, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to effectively identify and resolve application\-related issues. * You can demonstrate the ability to develop, maintain, test, and support reliable, user\-focused applications and technology solutions. * You know how to handle sensitive information and maintain confidentiality with the utmost discretion while adhering to established policies and security practices. * You will work collaboratively with IT staff, end users, and agency personnel in a professional office environment to understand needs and deliver effective technology solutions. * You can demonstrate adaptability, attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous learning, staying current with evolving technologies and improving application functionality and user experience. Additional Information * In addition to the resume, a cover letter is required to apply. Special Assistant (MA)\-MGRL \- 0668A **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college, including or supplemented by twenty\-four (24\) semester credits in computer science or a related computer field and two (2\) years of satisfactory full\-time software experience in designing, programming, debugging, maintaining, implementing, and enhancing computer software applications, systems programming, systems analysis and design, data communication software, or database design and programming, including one year in a project leader capacity or as a major contributor on a complex project; or * A four\-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent and six (6\) years of full\-time satisfactory software experience as described in “1" above, including one year in a project leader capacity or as a major contributor on a complex project. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- \- The preferred candidate will bring the following skills and experience to this position: \- Agile/Scrum development practices and experience with tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps. \- Experience with data integration and ETL processes, with familiarity with Azure Data Factory or SSIS. \- Experience with AI/ML integration, including Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, or similar. \- Familiarity with GitHub Copilot or other AI orchestration tools. \- Knowledge of NoSQL databases such as Azure Cosmos DB or MongoDB. \- C\#, ASP.NET Core, JavaScript \- HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Vue.js or React or Angular \- Azure cloud services (App Services, Application Insights, Blob Storage) \- Experience with Git and Agile/Scrum workflows in Azure DevOps or GitHub \- Experience working with RESTful web services \- Familiarity with Docker and containerization \- Scripting or automation experience (PowerShell, Bash, or Python) \- Good writing, communication, and team collaboration skills and requirements gathering \- Ability to conduct quality assurance and design performance tests using testing procedures. **Public Service Loan Forgiveness** ----------------------------------- As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal loan forgiveness programs and state repayment assistance programs. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website at https://studentaid.gov/pslf/. **Residency Requirement** ------------------------- New York City residency is generally required within 90 days of appointment. However, City Employees in certain titles who have worked for the City for 2 continuous years may also be eligible to reside in Nassau, Suffolk, Putnam, Westchester, Rockland, or Orange County. To determine if the residency requirement applies to you, please discuss with the agency representative at the time of the interview. **Additional Information** -------------------------- The City of New York is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment based upon any legally protected status or protected characteristic, including but not limited to an individual's sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity, or pregnancy. jobs.title: Backend Developer (Python & AI)
jobs.description: **About the Role** SaaS Rationalization LLC is building a software platform that helps businesses understand and optimize the software they use. The goal is to identify unnecessary or overlapping SaaS applications, improve visibility into software usage, reduce unnecessary costs, and make software management more efficient. To support this product, we are looking for a **Backend Developer with strong Python experience and practical AI/ML experience**. The platform will use backend services to process software and business data, while AI capabilities will help analyze information, identify patterns, and support intelligent recommendations and automation. **What You’ll Work On** * Build and maintain backend services and APIs using **Python** * Develop data processing and business logic for our SaaS optimization platform * Integrate and work with **AI/ML models and APIs** * Build backend workflows that support AI\-powered analysis and recommendations * Work with databases and external service integrations * Deploy and maintain backend services in **AWS** * Improve reliability, performance, security, and scalability of backend systems **Requirements** * Strong professional experience with **Python backend development** * Experience building production APIs and backend services * Practical experience with **AI/ML technologies**, such as **PyTorch**, model integration, or similar frameworks * Experience working with relational or document databases * Hands\-on experience deploying applications to **AWS** * Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills * Ability to work independently in an early\-stage product environment **Nice to Have** * Experience with FastAPI, Django, or Flask * Experience with LLMs, AI APIs, or recommendation systems * Experience with Docker and cloud\-based deployments * Experience building SaaS or B2B software **Why This Technology Matters** We specifically need a developer who can combine **Python backend engineering with AI/ML experience** because our product is not simply a traditional SaaS management dashboard. We are building systems that can process software\-related data and use intelligent analysis to help businesses discover inefficiencies and make better software decisions. That requires a strong backend foundation in Python together with practical experience integrating and deploying AI capabilities. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Parental leave Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description: About the team **AI Platform scales SPREEAI's infrastructure:** productionizing ML model checkpoints, running the API services behind the Partner Portal and partner integrations, optimizing inference serving, and giving ML Scientists training\-as\-a\-service so they can iterate without managing infrastructure themselves. It's the layer between research and the product our partners actually touch. jobs.title: Controls Engineer Co-op (Spring 2027)
jobs.description: Powerex\-Iwata Air Technology Inc. As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best. Come join a team where People make the difference! As a part of Marmon Holdings, Inc., a highly decentralized organization, we rely heavily on people with the aptitude, attitude, and entrepreneurial spirit to drive our success, and we're committed to attracting and retaining top talent. Position Description: As the Controls Engineering Co\-op at Powerex, Inc. you will have the opportunity to support the engineering group. You will work with mechanical and electrical engineers of diverse backgrounds to develop solutions to manufacturing issues and design new products. Engineers with experience levels ranging from recent graduates to 30\+ years of experience will support you as you develop design skills including PLC, Human Machine Interfaces (HMI) and Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) programming, problem\-solving ability, insight into different types of engineering roles, and gain experience with the design process. The project\-based approach to this co\-op will allow you to contribute to ongoing development projects and perform product line maintenance. As a co\-op onsite at Powerex you will work in an office, engineering lab, and assembly line/manufacturing environments. To be successful in this co\-op you will need to be open to a variety of activities that support the engineering team and embrace new challenges that will come as you gain experience. Example tasks based on co\-op experience level are below. * First Term Assignments: + Supporting team members in creating job packets for Production to build orders. + Assisting team members in the creation and maintenance of engineering drawings. + Assisting team members in resolving issues on the Production floor. + Programming HMI’s to add new functionality. * Second Term Assignments: + Design and implementation of small projects intended to improve the existing line of products. Various projects are available for assignment progressing in difficulty. + Executing and implementing Engineering Change Notices. + Learn start\-of\-the\-art ePlan design software. * Third Term Assignments: + Participation in New Product Development projects. This includes concept ideation, design, prototyping, and testing along with production implementation. + Design and implementation of more complex sustaining projects intended to improve the existing line of products. These may include significant product enhancements and quality improvements with a higher level of difficulty required for successful completion. **Qualifications** * Minimum of 1\-year engineering focused higher education completed at start of co\-op. * Minimum 3\.0 GPA * Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite * Ability to work independently and in teams. * Electrical aptitude with a passion for designing systems with HMI’s and PLC’s. * Experience with basic laboratory electronic equipment (oscilloscopes, signal generators, power supplies, multimeters, etc.) preferred **Company Description:** Hospital breathing air, laboratory nitrogen generators, bus kneeling capability, and many other applications require clean, dry, compressed air. Since 1988, Powerex has focused on designing and manufacturing reliable systems that supply compressed air and vacuum for these markets at the best value. Powerex has a full in\-house engineering staff, which allows for the customization of systems and the development innovative new products to meet the needs of customers and changing markets. Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job\-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Fintech (Money Movement & Payments)
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Director of Product, Fintech (Money Movement \& Payments) **Team:** Product **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Reports To:** SVP of Product \& Technology ### **About Plug** Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. Consumers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing, battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end\-to\-end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from these consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory. Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $100M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI\-native startup team in Los Angeles, full of operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth. ### **Why Plug** * You'll own a piece of the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You'll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You'll be part of an AI\-native company. We're rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level. * You'll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You'll have real ownership, high autonomy, and a direct line to company outcomes. ### **The Opportunity** Every transaction on Plug \- a consumer trade\-in payout, a dealer's winning bid, a lien payoff to a lender, a title transfer \- has money attached to it, and today that money moves through a patchwork of manual processes, bank wires, and one\-off integrations. As Plug scales toward its next stage of growth, we need someone to turn that patchwork into real infrastructure: instant, reliable, and built to handle increasingly complex flows of funds across consumers, dealers, lenders, and banking partners. We're hiring a Director of Product to own money movement, payments, and lending\-adjacent product end\-to\-end, from a product standpoint \- including every internal and external stakeholder relationship that touches the flow of funds. This is a director\-level role by design: we need someone who can run the fintech stack independently, make sound calls under ambiguity, and manage bank, servicer, and partner relationships directly, without requiring hands\-on involvement from company leadership on day\-to\-day fintech decisions. ### **What You'll Do** * Own the product strategy and roadmap for money movement across the platform: consumer payouts, dealer payments, auction settlement, lien payoffs, and title\-related fund flows. * Design and ship the systems that move money instantly and reliably at scale, replacing manual and semi\-manual processes with real infrastructure. * Manage and grow relationships with external partners \- banks, payment processors, lien/title servicers, and lending partners \- negotiating terms, integrations, and SLAs directly. * Run the full flow of funds independently: from origination and disbursement through settlement, reconciliation, and payoff, with a clear view into where funds sit and why at every stage. * Partner closely with Engineering, Risk, Finance, and Operations to ensure every dollar movement is compliant, auditable, and fast. * Identify and scope opportunities to bring lending or financing\-adjacent products into the platform (e.g., dealer floor plan, consumer bridge financing, payment plans) as the business grows. * Build the operating rhythm, metrics, and monitoring needed to catch and resolve payment or settlement issues before they become customer\-facing problems. * Design partnership ecosystem and negotiate with banking and payments partners and help define which partnerships to pursue as the company scales. ### **What You'll Bring** * 7\+ years in product management * Meaningful time spent owning payments end\-to\-end at a marketplace or large payments platform company * A track record of managing external stakeholders directly \- banks, servicers, processors, or lending partners \- including negotiating terms and owning the relationship, not just the integration. * Direct experience with the mechanics of fund flows: settlement, disbursement, reconciliation, payoff processing, and the compliance and risk considerations that come with each. * Demonstrated ability to operate independently at a senior level \- this role is scoped for someone who can be the final decision\-maker on fintech product questions, not someone who escalates most decisions upward. * Comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast\-moving environment where you're often the first and only product owner for a given domain. * Strong technical fluency \- you can go deep with engineers on system design, data models, and API tradeoffs for payment infrastructure. * International or cross\-border payments experience is a plus, but not required. * Prior title, marketplace, or auction/lending experience in automotive or a comparable regulated industry is a plus. * A bias toward building lean, fast infrastructure over off\-the\-shelf process \- you'd rather ship the real solution than duct\-tape a workaround. ### **Compensation and Benefits** Annual salary: P6 $222,465 \- $255,174 Salary ranges reflect independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an individual's actual offer falls within that range depends on a combination of factors, including relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and prevailing market conditions. Ranges are reviewed periodically and may be adjusted to reflect changing market conditions. **Benefits \& Perks:** * Health, Vision, and Dental insurance * 401(k) plan * 30 days work from anywhere per calendar year * Daily lunch stipend * Equity (based on role and performance) * Unlimited PTO * Fully stocked kitchen * Dog\-friendly office * Ongoing opportunities for growth and development This full\-time position is based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles) and is an in\-person role. We welcome candidates from all locations to apply, provided they are willing to relocate for the role. Relocation assistance will not be provided for successful candidates. Sponsorship not available at this time. ### **Acknowledgments** Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We believe diverse teams build better products.

jobs.title: Distribution Engineer 2
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** At POWERX, we make power work. We deliver engineering, protection and control, commissioning, NETA field services, and compliance, supporting the full lifecycle of power infrastructure. With a multinational footprint across the United State and Canada, we bring technical depth and field\-proven experience to every project. POWERX is built on four pillars, with our people as the foundation. Guided by our values, HEART, our people\-first culture shapes how we show up for each other and for our clients because we believe the best work comes from people who feel valued and supported. That commitment to excellence has been recognized nationally, including Great Place to Work, Fortune Best Workplace in Construction, and Power Best Companies. Through our family of brands, POWERX Edge expands that promise with turnkey solutions across critical power infrastructure. Our edge is the ability to connect specialized expertise through one integrated platform, helping customers plan, build, energize, protect, and optimize power infrastructure with confidence. In an industry where technology and complexity are ever\-changing, we're ready to help you meet today's challenges while preparing for tomorrow's innovations. Work with a team that's powered by excellence. **POWERX Edge Brands Overview** Mission\-critical Level I–V facility \& mechanical commissioning, design review through owner turnover. A2LA Field Evaluation Body. 30\+ years of experience via Genelco by POWERX Edge. The POWERX Edge brand also offers a direct gateway for utilities services, including, distribution engineering, P\&C, SCADA validation, wiring, construction support \& reliability. Elect, A POWERX Company offers electrical \& power\-systems engineering, studies, utility \& substation design serving NC, GA, VA \& NY. All other services roll up under our main platform, POWERX, supporting the full lifecycle of power infrastructure. **OUR POWERX Edge PERKS** * Competitive Pay * Incentives for Certifications * Referral Bonus Program * Tuition Reimbursement * Medical, dental, vision, LTD, STD, Basic Life/AD\&D, and other ancillary products * 401k program with a company match * Performance Program * Paid Parental Leave * PTO including Wellness Days and Paid Holidays * And much more! **Job Summary:** The Distribution Engineer II is responsible for the engineering design, cost estimation, project coordination, and field inspection of electric power distribution projects. This role supports other departments and delivers cost\-effective, safe, and high\-quality solutions for our clients, ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** * None. **Duties/Responsibilities:** Engineering \& Project Management * Design, estimate, and coordinate the construction of overhead and underground power distribution systems for residential, commercial, and industrial customers. * Lead and manage "Capital" and "O\&M" projects through all phases of development, from concept to closeout. * Identify and implement innovative engineering solutions to improve system reliability, cost efficiency, and safety. Safety \& Quality * Demonstrate a strong safety culture, consistently applying the highest standards for personal and team safety practices. * Ensure his engineering work product meets internal quality standards and complies with regulatory guidelines. Training and Development * Continue developing interpreting and applying construction bulletins, standards, and engineering procedures. * Stay current with evolving industry trends and participate in ongoing training and certification programs. Field Inspection \& Compliance * Ensure his engineering work product meets internal quality standards and complies with regulatory guidelines. * Participates during recommendations and engineering modifications which ensure system integrity and code adherence. Research and Report Writing * Prepare accurate project documentation, reports, and technical analyses. * Maintain records related to project progress, cost, and compliance. Client Relations and Support * Serve as a primary technical contact for client stakeholders, ensuring responsiveness and technical excellence. * Address client concerns with professionalism and provide clear, actionable solutions. * Continue building and maintaining good client partnerships that support long\-term engagement and satisfaction. Additional responsibilities and tasks as required to support the organization's goals and adapt to evolving business needs. **Attributes/Abilities:** * Must have a satisfactory background/MVR check. * Must pass a pre\-employment, post\-accident, reasonable suspicion, and/or random drug test. * Attention to detail and accuracy. * Possess good verbal and written communication skills. * Knowledge of customer tools such as: JETS, GIS, SOCKET, TCMS \& DistView. * Knowledge of NEC, NESC, Distribution Bulletins, Engineering Handbook, Distribution Specifications, Distribution Operating Procedures, ARC Flash Requirements, Metering Blue Book \& Franchise Manual. * Strong customer service skills. * Ability to prioritize tasks and work independently or part of a team. * Possess project management skills. * Effective communication and interpersonal skills. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Acrobat. **Experience and Education:** * Bachelor's degree in engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Civil or General). * 1\-3 years of progressive engineering experience. * EIT or PE license preferred. * Technical skills and familiarity with industry standards. **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to work safely around electrical and mechanical hazards. * Operates light measuring instruments. * Potential minimum exposure to various conditions, including dirt, heat, fumes, smoke, water, noise, vibration, grease, oil, and dust. * Requires field work in industrial environments. * Ability and willingness to work occasional excess straight time as needed. * May require travel 25% of the time. **POWERX is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.**

jobs.title: Factory Automation Engineer I
jobs.description: **Summary** The Factory Automation Engineer supports the installation, commissioning, operation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of factory automation equipment within a high\-volume manufacturing environment. This role supports automation system reliability, equipment performance, and production continuity through technical problem solving, equipment optimization, and collaboration with equipment manufacturers, contractors, and internal stakeholders. This is an entry\-level engineering position with development opportunity into more advanced automation engineering responsibilities. **Responsibilities** * Analyze automation\-related failures, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime and improve system reliability * Support emergency response for critical automation issues affecting production continuity * Work cross\-functionally with Factory Automation, IT, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, and Controls teams to troubleshoot and resolve equipment, system, and communication issues * Support the installation, commissioning, stabilization, and qualification of new automation equipment to support production ramp\-up and operational readiness * Assist with the implementation and integration of new technologies into production lines, including vision systems, laser systems, sensors, PLC\-integrated devices, and automated material handling systems * Coordinate with equipment manufacturers, contractors, and internal stakeholders to support issue escalation, equipment upgrades, installation activities, and system improvements * Monitor equipment performance and support continuous jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Founding Product Engineer** **Jampack AI · Full\-time · New York City (In\-office) · Reports to CEO \& CTO** **About Jampack** Jampack builds AI agents that run wholesale operations, replacing spreadsheets, email chains, and manual data entry with automated workflows. We power brands like Fishwife, immi, and PATH, handling everything from purchase orders and freight coordination to invoicing and payment reconciliation. We’ve raised a $3\.2M seed round led by Maveron, Timber Grove Ventures, and industry operators. We’re a small team working closely with customers to build the AI\-native operating system for wholesale. **The Role** We’re hiring our first dedicated design hire: a founding product engineer with impeccable taste who will own how the product looks, feels, and works. You might be an engineer who designs or a designer who codes. Either way, you can take an idea, figure out how it should work, and build a polished interface that customers use. Our customers run wholesale operations. They’re managing orders, coordinating shipments, and keeping their businesses moving. We want to make complex, consequential work feel calm, fast, and intuitive. You’ll primarily create new product experiences from scratch. You own the experience, design, and frontend implementation, partnering with engineers on the backend. A central part of the job is discovering how people should interact with AI agents that do real work on their behalf. **What You’ll Do** * **Own experiences from first sketch to production.** Work through user flows, explore designs, build prototypes, ship the frontend, and watch customers use it. * **Make complex workflows feel simple.** Turn dense information and operational detail into clear interfaces that help people understand what matters and what to do next. * **Discover how people should work with agents.** Explore and test interaction patterns that make the product understandable, useful, and easy to trust. * **Build the foundations for consistent craft.** Create reusable components and patterns that help the whole team ship better interfaces faster. * **Work directly with customers.** Learn how operators think, test prototypes with them, and use their feedback to improve what you ship. **What We’re Looking For** * **4\+ years of experience designing and building products at fast\-growing startups.** You can show us work you personally took from idea to production, how you adapted to changing priorities, and how you balanced shipping quickly with a high bar for craft. * **Exceptional UI/UX taste.** You have a point of view on what good looks and feels like, and you can explain the decisions behind your work. * **The ability to design and build.** You have strong frontend fundamentals and can independently ship production interfaces. * **Thoughtful systems thinking.** You recognize when a component or interaction pattern can make several parts of the product better. * **Initiative and follow\-through.** You can take an incomplete idea, ask useful questions, share work early, and carry it through to a working product. * **Curiosity about AI experiences.** You’re excited to explore what software can become when agents can take action for the user. Have fewer than four years of experience? We also welcome exceptional early\-career candidates whose work demonstrates strong taste and an ability to ship. Personal projects, experiments, and professional work all count. **Why Jampack** * **Shape the product from the beginning.** As our first dedicated design hire, you’ll establish the patterns and level of craft the team builds on. * **Work on an open design problem.** How people work alongside AI agents is still being figured out. You’ll help discover what works. * **Build for real customers moving the real economy.** You’ll have direct access to the operators using your work and see how your decisions affect their day\-to\-day operations. * **Work closely with the founders.** You’ll partner directly with the CEO and CTO, with engineering support to bring your ideas into production. **Show Us Your Work** Share whatever best demonstrates your taste and ability to ship: a live product, side project, prototype, portfolio, or something else you’ve made. Tell us what you personally designed and built, and one decision you’re proud of. **Compensation** **$160,000–$220,000 base salary \+ meaningful equity**

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Austin, TX (WFH)
jobs.description: Full\-Stack Engineer Build. Solve. Own It. At **Vironix**, we're working to make the world a healthier place by changing how healthcare providers monitor and respond to patients. Vironix Health uses advanced AI and remote monitoring to help detect deterioration from viral and chronic illness — giving clinicians better information and patients a better chance to get the right care at the right time. We're a very small team of scientists, technologists, and builders working on a big problem. That means we're not looking for someone who needs a detailed job description telling them exactly where their responsibilities begin and end. We're looking for a **Full\-Stack Engineer who likes to build things.** You'll work directly with our CTO and engineering team to develop and improve the web and mobile applications used by patients and clinicians. You'll write code across the stack, work with APIs and backend services, troubleshoot problems, and take an idea from concept to production. We're much more interested in **how you think and what you've built** than whether your resume lists a particular collection of technologies. What You'll Do * Build and improve web and mobile applications using React, React Native, and other technologies as appropriate. * Work across the stack — including frontend, backend APIs, databases, and application logic. * Write, read, and debug code in Python and other languages. * Work with relational databases, including PostgreSQL. * Take ownership of features and problems from beginning to end rather than waiting for someone else to handle the other half. * Work closely with our CTO and engineering team to turn ideas and requirements into working products. * Help determine **how** something should be built, not just execute someone else's instructions. * Explore and incorporate AI and emerging technologies when they can make the product, development process, or user experience better. * Troubleshoot, experiment, learn, and figure things out when the answer isn't obvious. * Contribute to a product that is being used in real healthcare environments and has real consequences for patients and clinicians. **Requirements** What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who is comfortable wearing a lot of hats. You should be someone who: * Has professional coding experience in at least one language and can learn new technologies when necessary. * Has experience developing applications, preferably including mobile applications. * Is comfortable working across the stack rather than staying inside a narrow specialty. * Can work independently without needing every task broken down into detailed instructions. * Enjoys solving problems where there may not be an established process or obvious answer. * Is excited about AI and interested in finding practical ways to use it — not someone who sees it as a threat to the way they've always worked. * Has experience working with small teams where individual contributions matter and ownership is high. * Doesn't need a lot of structure, bureaucracy, or handoffs to get things done. * Is willing to challenge assumptions and ask, **"Is there a better way to do this?"** * Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks. * Has a genuine interest in building technology that can make a difference in healthcare. Experience That Gets Our Attention We're especially interested in people who have: * Recent startup experience * Built and launched applications rather than simply maintaining someone else's code * Worked on small engineering teams with significant individual ownership * Experience with React, React Native, Python, PostgreSQL, or cloud infrastructure * Experience incorporating AI into products or development workflows * A history of learning new technologies quickly to solve a problem **The specific tools you have used matter less to us than your ability to learn, build, and solve problems.** Why Vironix? This isn't a role where you'll spend six months waiting for a committee to approve a change. We're a small team. Your work will have visibility. Your decisions will matter. And what you build can make its way into the hands of clinicians and patients. You'll work directly with our CTO, have a meaningful voice in how products are built, and have the opportunity to help shape both the technology and the way we work. * Competitive salary based on experience * Equity participation in a high\-growth health\-tech company * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Hybrid schedule with intentional in\-person collaboration * Direct impact on technology being used in real clinical care * Small team with high ownership and little bureaucracy * An environment that values **results, initiative, and good ideas over hours logged** Location Our core team is based in **Austin, Texas**. We work primarily remotely with a few intentional days of in\-person collaboration each month.

jobs.description: **About us** ============ Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best\-in\-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web. We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world\-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission. **The role:** ============= You will build and operate the security foundations that protect Parallel’s production infrastructure, internal systems, and access to both. You will own how people, services, and agents authenticate, what they can reach, how production is hardened, and how security controls are enforced from source code through running workloads. You will work across identity and access, cloud and Kubernetes security, software supply chain integrity, logging and detection infrastructure, endpoint security, and recovery. You will design secure defaults engineers inherit rather than configure, and build the systems that make access, changes, and recovery measurable and auditable. You will also help define how AI coding agents operate inside Parallel’s own infrastructure, including what they can access, what privileges they receive, and how their actions are constrained and logged. **About you:** ============== Have deep intuition on cloud infrastructure, identity, network security, and production systems. You like to reason about which controls materially reduce risk and which ones mostly create process. You write and ship code, prefer automation over manual controls, and are comfortable working at the boundary between security, platform engineering, and reliability. You can land changes across teams you do not manage, make practical tradeoffs, and build durable security foundations rather than controls that need constant tending. **You might be a good fit if you have:** ======================================== * Significant experience building or operating infrastructure or security systems in production cloud environments * Deep experience in at least one of identity and authorization, cloud and Kubernetes security, or logging and detection platforms * Strong cloud, network, secrets management, and workload isolation fundamentals * Experience building secure deployment pipelines, including artifact provenance, immutability, secret scanning, and software supply chain controls * Experience designing centralized logging, alerting, and detection infrastructure across cloud, SaaS, identity, and endpoints * Strong production coding and automation skills in Terraform, Python, Go, or similar tools * A track record of shipping security controls across an engineering organization, including making tradeoffs to get them adopted * Experience with endpoint security, device trust, recovery planning, SOC 2, customer audits, or contractual security requirements is a plus * Experience securing AI or agentic systems is a plus **Life at Parallel** ==================== Our team works **fully in\-person**, between our Palo Alto HQ and San Francisco office. We’re a flat, talent\-dense organization dedicated to solving technical and creative problems. We seek like\-minded individuals who share our passion for applying science, creativity, and consistency to big and complex problems with equally big outcomes. These are our values: * **Own customer impact:** It’s on us to ensure real\-world outcomes for our customers. * **Obsess over craft:** Perfect every detail because quality compounds. * **Accelerate change**: Ship fast, adapt faster, and move frontier ideas into production. * **Create win\-wins**: Creatively turn trade\-offs into upside. * **Make high\-conviction bets**: Try and fail. But succeed an unfair amount. **Compensation \& benefits** ============================ * Competitive salary * Generous equity * Visa sponsorships * 401K plans * Daily lunch \& office snacks * Dinner at the office * Unlimited vacation * Caltrain pass reimbursement Compensation Range: $150K \- $300K

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ **MintMCP** helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. **AI\-Native Startup** We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team, write code, review PRs, and handle sales, marketing, and deal ops on the same gateway we sell to customers. We are building an entire company operating system around them, and you will help build it. **Traction** Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it. Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security\-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers. We hire across levels, from strong early\-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship. **About You** * You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open\-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals. * You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience. * You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity. * You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents. * You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs. * You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast. * You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem. * You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process. **Nice to have:** * Developer\-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale. * Background in security, identity, or permission systems. * Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks. * Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure. **What we offer:** * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. * Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers. * Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell. * Direct access to the founders, customer context, and product direction, with mentorship as you grow. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.description: **Job Title:** Staff Product Designer **Team:** Product **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Reports To:** SVP, Product \& Technology ### **About Plug** Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. Consumers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing, battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end\-to\-end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from these consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory. Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $100M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI\-native startup team in Los Angeles, full of operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth. ### **Why Plug** * You'll own a piece of the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You'll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You'll be part of an AI\-native company. We're rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level. * You'll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You'll have real ownership, high autonomy, and a direct line to company outcomes. **The Opportunity** We are looking for a Product Designer to own design across Plug, from the consumer selling experience through the dealer and partner tools. You will report to the SVP of Product and Technology. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will own your surface end\-to\-end, paired closely with product and engineering, operating with high agency. You talk to customers directly, form a point of view, and ship. You will not wait on a committee or a process. Most of the value you create will come from how well you understand the people using what you build. You will also set the bar. We move fast, and AI is a real part of how we work \- which means the risk isn't velocity, it's sameness. We're looking for someone who uses every tool available to help the team ship quickly and on target, and who also knows which moments deserve soul and will fight for them. **What You'll Do** * Own end\-to\-end design for our OEM, commercial partner, and dealer\-facing surfaces, from early concept through shipped, polished product. * Set the bar for taste and craft across Plug. You'll be the standard the company calibrates against. * Define how we build. You'll design the systems that let design scale \- our design system, prototyping and handoff workflows, and how we use tools like Claude Design \- so a small team ships fast without drifting from our brand, our craft bar, or what customers actually need. * Lead customer research directly \- interviews, contextual inquiry, usability testing \- to build a deep, first\-hand understanding of how partners and dealers actually work. * Bring a curious, AI\-forward mindset \- you understand how product, engineering, and design work together in an AI\-native workflow * Help empower teams to move fast with AI while maintaining strong design governance * Translate complex B2B workflows (inventory processing, bidding, API\-driven integrations) into interfaces that are simple, fast, and jobs.title: Technical Architect, Money Systems (Staff / Principal Engineer)
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Technical Architect, Money Systems (Staff / Principal Engineer) **Team:** Engineering **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Reports To:** Head of Engineering / CTO ### **About Plug** Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. Consumers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing, battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end\-to\-end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from these consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory. Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $100M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI\-native startup team in Los Angeles, full of operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth. ### **Why Plug** * You'll own a piece of the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You'll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You'll be part of an AI\-native company. We're rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level. * You'll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You'll have real ownership, high autonomy, and a direct line to company outcomes. ### **The Opportunity** Every transaction on Plug moves real money \- consumer payouts, dealer settlements, lien payoffs, auction proceeds \- and today those flows run on infrastructure that was built to get us to $100M in volume, not to $1B. We need a technical architect to design the money systems that get us there: a ledger and payments architecture that's correct, auditable, and fast, built to survive contact with banking partners, regulators, and scale. We believe building consumer\-facing product architecture and building money\-facing architecture are fundamentally different disciplines, and rarely the same person's strength. This role exists because we need someone whose primary craft is the latter: designing systems that hold up under regulatory scrutiny, banking\-partner constraints, and financial audit \- not just under user load. ### **What You'll Do** * Own the architecture for Plug's money\-facing systems: ledger, payment disbursement, settlement, reconciliation, and lien/title payoff processing. * Design a ledger that is deterministic, auditable, and gives a single, queryable source of truth for every dollar that moves through the platform. * Architect systems that integrate directly with banking partners, payment processors, and lien/title servicers \- working within the regulatory and compliance constraints those partnerships require, and doing so elegantly rather than with brittle workarounds. * Make and document the core technical tradeoffs for financial systems: consistency vs. availability, idempotency, fault tolerance, and failure recovery for transaction\-critical infrastructure. * Partner with Product, Risk, Finance, and Compliance to translate business and regulatory requirements into system design. * Set technical standards and review architecture for any system that touches money, acting as the final technical guardrail before it ships. * Mentor and raise the technical bar for engineers working in and around the money systems domain, without owning formal people management. * Evaluate and help decide when to build vs. integrate with external payments/banking infrastructure providers. ### **What You'll Bring** * 10\+ years in software engineering, with 5\+ years working on B2B and B2C payments solutions. * Direct experience designing and building payments, ledger, lending, or money movement infrastructure \- not just consumer\-facing payment systems. * A genuine taste for elegance: the ability to design within real regulatory and stakeholder constraints in a way that stays efficient and clean, rather than accumulating one\-off exceptions and technical debt to satisfy each new requirement. * Proven experience designing systems within regulatory and banking\-partner constraints \- you understand what it takes to build infrastructure that a bank, processor, or regulator will actually sign off on. * Deep expertise in distributed systems: transaction integrity, financial data consistency, idempotency, auditability, and fault tolerance at scale. * A track record of owning architecture decisions end\-to\-end, from design through implementation and long\-term maintainability. * Comfort operating with high agency in an ambiguous, fast\-moving startup environment \- you'll be the first and primary technical owner of this domain. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills \- you can translate complex technical tradeoffs for Product, Risk, Finance, and Compliance stakeholders. * International or cross\-border money movement experience is a plus, but not required. * Experience with title, lien, lending, or marketplace escrow\-like flows is a plus. * You work agent\-first. You are comfortable orchestrating multiple coding agents, defining clear acceptance criteria, and reviewing AI\-generated output to a high bar \- and you have a point of view on where that is and is not appropriate in code that moves money. ### **Compensation and Benefits** Annual salary: $222,256 \-$259,324 Salary ranges reflect independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an individual's actual offer falls within that range depends on a combination of factors, including relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and prevailing market conditions. Ranges are reviewed periodically and may be adjusted to reflect changing market conditions. **Benefits \& Perks:** * Health, Vision, and Dental insurance * 401(k) plan * 30 days work from anywhere per calendar year * Daily lunch stipend * Equity (based on role and performance) * Unlimited PTO * Fully stocked kitchen * Dog\-friendly office * Ongoing opportunities for growth and development This full\-time position is based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles) and is an in\-person role. We welcome candidates from all locations to apply, provided they are willing to relocate for the role. Relocation assistance will not be provided for successful candidates. Sponsorship not available at this time. ### **Acknowledgments** Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products.

jobs.description: **Software Engineer Lead eBiz** =============================== This job is available in 3 locations See all Category Technology JR202638732 Onsite Software Engineer Lead eBiz The Software Engineer Lead has a strong foundation in software engineering and distributed systems design, and knows how to turn ambiguous problems into simple, scalable solutions. This person is a fast learner and strong collaborator who can lead an agile team, keep work visible and moving to "Done," and drive continuous improvement through iteration and retrospectives. This role practices outcome\-based engineering where success is defined by the real\-world impact of member value, business results, adoption and not by output alone (tickets closed, features shipped, roadmap completion). This person is expected to challenge scope, propose simpler paths to the same result, and own whether a solution actually moves the intended outcome, not just whether it was delivered as specified. This role strengthens Club Labs' technical agility across our product lines, including building secure, well\-governed agentic AI platforms and experiences for both members and employees. **Job Duties** * Design and develop software applications and distributed systems across web, mobile, and AI\-powered products. Write clean code, resolve application issues, and recommend architecture and tooling improvements including when AI/ML is (or isn't) the right approach. * Contribute to the design and development of agentic AI platforms including conversational and autonomous agents that serve both member\-facing experiences (e.g., self\-service, support) and internal employee productivity use cases. * Apply security, privacy, and governance best practices across web, mobile, and AI/agentic systems including data protection, access controls, and responsible\-AI safeguards (e.g., guardrails, PII handling, human\-in\-the\-loop review). * Supervise team members on design and implementation of new functionality, ensuring solutions align with the organization's technical vision. * Stay current on emerging technologies, AI and otherwise, and evaluate their impact on business and member value. * Exercise independent judgment on architecture, technology choices, and project direction to help drive outcomes. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's in computer science or related field \- Preferred * 10\+ years building high\-performance, reliable, secure software, with demonstrated distributed systems design experience \- Required * Hands\-on experience with modern AI/LLM tools, agentic systems, or applied ML (depth of understanding matters more than specific tools used) \- Required * Solid grounding in security fundamentals across web, mobile, LLM, and agentic workflows (e.g., authentication/authorization, data privacy, prompt injection, and agent\-specific attack vectors) \- Required * Solid grasp of API \& Event Driven architecture \-Required * Strong presentation skills to explain technical tradeoffs to engineers and non\-technical stakeholders alike \- Required * 1\-3 years supervisory experience \- Preferred * Understanding of communication protocols for AI, such as MCP or A2A \- Preferred **Travel Requirements** * Occasional travel to off\-site meetings or conferences (5%). jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description: **“*****At Absorb, we cultivate a culture of curiosity and continuous growth, both for ourselves and for our customers. We’re passionate about unlocking potential, challenging the status quo, and building solutions that empower our clients to achieve their boldest goals. Here, every day is an opportunity to innovate, learn, and make a meaningful impact. If you’re a Strategic Account Manager eager to make a real difference and empower organizations to be at the cutting edge of learning, this is your opportunity to build something truly special."*** \- James Levine, VP, Strategic Account Management The Strategic Account Manager is a critical role at Absorb. We’re looking for someone who has demonstrated experience working with large, complex organizations having built strategic account plans and has gone on to successfully close meaningful land and expand opportunities with those accounts. Your past experiences, advice, and your sales acumen will have a direct impact on Absorb’s mission. We’re looking for someone to step into the role with deep experience who can build relationships quickly and identify where opportunities exist in our current customer base. From there, you’ll need to communicate internally what you need to help you execute on those plans to see significant expansion within our most strategic customers. This role will be supported by all levels and sectors of Absorb. You’ll be able to interface with teams and executives across all business units at Absorb to help you, and our customers, succeed. If this sounds familiar and exciting to you, then we’re thrilled to have you join Absorb and make a big impact! Absorb Culture \- Absorb LMS **What you’ll do:** * Build trust and strong business relationships with key decision makers in Absorb’s most opportune accounts * Generate strategic account plans to execute strategies which will lead to upsell/cross sell opportunities * Work with internal resources (Leadership, Solutions Engineers, Account Development reps) to develop and execute expansion plans from Discovery to Closed Won * Monitor your pipeline to ensure appropriate actions are taken at appropriate times to continue to facilitate the sale to closed won * Work collaboratively with the support and technology teams to become an expert in Absorb LMS and the overall learning management landscape. * Demonstrate Absorb LMS functionality and provide pricing options that align to customer objectives and assist Absorb’s continued growth * Work with existing Customer Success resources to identify risk and mitigate churn wherever possible * Use customer and prospect contact activities tools and systems, and update relevant information held in these systems * Monitor and report on market and competitor activities and provide relevant reports and information **What you’ll bring:** * Strong background in technology sales and client management with a minimum 7\+ years of experience * Ability to become a trusted advisor to senior leaders within client organizations * Very strong business communication skills (written and verbal) * Experience working with a global client base * Ability to travel for business when required * Strong internal team player **Additional preferred qualifications:** * Post\-secondary degree – business undergraduate degree or MBA **Technologies we use:** * AbsorbLMS, Salesforce, Gainsight, Zendesk, Calendly, Zoom, Teams, Adobe Acrobat **Are you ready to become an Absorber?** **What we offer:** * Fully remote\-first work with flexible work arrangements * Comprehensive Health and Wellness Benefits including retirement savings programs, eligibility for two different bonus plans, generous time off, comprehensive medical and dental benefits based on your country of location * New Hire Equipment Allowance and monthly Flex Allowance to support your success * Endless opportunity for career growth and internal mobility * Employee driven DE\&I programs **Who are we?** Absorb Software is the leading global AI\-driven learning platform provider, helping organizations unlock the full potential of their workforce. With its innovative Strategic Learning Systems (SLS) approach, Absorb empowers businesses to align learning with strategic goals, driving measurable impact and workforce agility. The Absorb LMS platform delivers personalized, scalable, and engaging learning experiences for employees, customers, and partners worldwide. Trusted by over 3,300 organizations and 34 million users, Absorb is redefining the future of workplace learning through cutting\-edge AI, seamless integrations, and an unwavering commitment to innovation. We empower learners to enrich their lives, workplaces and communities. **Our values are simple:** * **We achieve exceptional results by genuinely caring about each other and the work we do** * **We’re united, and we grow through our commitment to elevating continual learning!** **AI @ Absorb** We believe in the power of AI and technology to make learning accessible to everyone. By exploring new tools and constantly experimenting, we’re redefining what’s possible. We take an AI‑first approach to unlock human potential, drive impact, and scale better outcomes. As the world evolves, Absorb is committed to growing with you. Investing in your skills every step of the way. We use AI tools to support our recruitment process, such as organizing applications and highlighting potential matches based on role requirements. While these tools help streamline our review, all screening and final hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team. We encourage candidates to apply authentically and not rely solely on AI\-generated responses in their applications. Absorb is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment for all our people. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications. Should you require any accommodation during the recruitment process, please indicate this on your application and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. For any questions, please contact us at accessiblecareers@absorblms.com Successful candidates for this position will be subject to pre\-employment background screening, including a criminal record check and must be able to show proof of legal eligibility to work in the country they have applied to without sponsorship.

This is a critical, **contract\-to\-hire** role designed for an entrepreneurial engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment and excels at 0\-to\-1 engineering.The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in building transactional platforms (such as marketplaces, commerce engines, or shopping cart workflows) and possesses the rare balance of **visionary architectural leadership** and **high\-impact, hands\-on coding**.**Key Responsibilities** * **Technical Leadership (0 → 1\):** Architect, design, and deliver the core backend infrastructure from scratch. jobs.description: **About NegotiateAI (Menlo Ventures Backed)** Today we're building AI for category managers at manufacturing and industrial companies, taking the grind out of indirect spend and delivering enterprises millions in savings. That's the starting point. Where we're going is general procurement AI that spans the entire function. If you're excited about solving hard technical problems and building a transformative product early, we'd love for you to join us. **About this role** You'll be one of the first engineers on the team, building the systems that power our AI\-driven procurement platform. You'll own meaningful pieces of the product end to end, and work directly with the founder and our earliest customers to figure out what to build next. This is a hands\-on role with a technical leadership component, but no direct reports. **What you'll do** * Build and own core backend services, including integrations with ERP systems, supplier databases, and spend analytics tools. * Build the agentic systems at the core of the product: pipelines that categorize indirect spend and resolve part identifiers from incomplete supplier data, and agents that source online benchmarks, gather supplier contacts, and support automated negotiation. * Ship customer\-facing features for real\-time spend visibility and supplier benchmarking, and iterate quickly on customer feedback. * Build evaluation and monitoring for our AI systems so we can measure accuracy and catch regressions before customers do. * Set architectural direction for the systems you own, and mentor engineers earlier in their careers. * Apply security and data privacy practices, including anonymization, tokenization, and secure sandboxes for model work. **Must haves** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping production systems end to end. * Strong backend engineering skills, including API design and data pipeline work. Depth matters more to us than experience in any particular language. * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs in production, including agentic workflows, tool use, context and retrieval strategies, and evaluation. * Experience shipping against messy real\-world data: cleaning, normalization, entity resolution, and establishing ground truth. * Comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP) and standard production practices: CI/CD, testing, and observability. * Product sense. You can take an ambiguous problem, talk to a customer, and decide what's actually worth building. * A drive to improve developer experience and team velocity in the AI era, through internal tooling and agent\-assisted workflows. * Comfort with early\-stage ambiguity: a small team, shifting priorities, and shipping before everything is fully specified. **Nice to haves** * Deep production experience with TypeScript. * Experience designing agent harnesses: the scaffolding that makes a model reliable in production. * Experience with ClickHouse, or with other columnar analytics stores such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks. * Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Coupa, or Ariba. * Background in procurement, supply chain, sourcing, or marketplace software. * Experience meeting SOC 2, GDPR, or similar compliance requirements at a startup. * Experience at an early\-stage startup (seed through Series B). * Experience across both B2B and B2C, with a sense of how to make enterprise software feel consumer\-grade.

jobs.title: Optical Sensor Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Introduction to the Job** --------------------------- As an **Optical Sensor Design Engineer** , you will help develop precision technologies that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Your work will contribute to the optical alignment systems inside ASML’s lithography machines. Based in Wilton, Connecticut, you will join the Wafer Alignment Sensor department. You will design, build, test, and integrate complex optical and photonic sensor systems. These systems combine light sources, detectors, fiber optics, electronics, and signal\-processing software. **Role and Responsibilities** ----------------------------- As an **Optical Sensor Design Engineer** , you will lead complex technical work and own module\-level design activities. You will collaborate with engineers across several disciplines to deliver reliable sensor solutions. * Design, develop, build, and integrate optical alignment sensor systems. * Build and align imaging, detector, fiber\-optic, and other optical systems. * Analyze test data to evaluate sensor performance and identify technical issues. * Lead root\-cause investigations, complex testing, and technical troubleshooting activities. * Develop, test, and improve signal\-processing algorithms and analysis methods. * Coordinate technical work across software, electronics, manufacturing, and equipment engineering teams. * Communicate technical findings clearly to engineering teams, customers, suppliers, and leaders. **Education and Experience** ---------------------------- * A bachelor’s degree in physics, optics, optical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical field. * At least two years of relevant engineering experience, including applicable graduate research. * A master’s degree in a related technical field is preferred. * Hands\-on experience building, testing, aligning, or troubleshooting optical systems. * Experience using MATLAB for data processing, analysis, or algorithm development. * Familiarity with Python or LabVIEW is preferred. * Experience working autonomously on complex technical assignments. * Strong written and verbal English communication skills. **Skills** ---------- Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems. To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills: * Apply analytical thinking to complex optical and system\-level problems. * Collaborate effectively with colleagues from different technical disciplines. * Translate data and stakeholder input into clear, evidence\-based conclusions. * Communicate technical information for both engineering and nontechnical audiences. * Take ownership of assignments and follow through on commitments. * Adapt priorities while maintaining accuracy, quality, and attention to detail. * Identify technical bottlenecks and recommend practical improvements. * Listen actively and contribute constructively during design and troubleshooting discussions. **Other Information** --------------------- * This position is located on\-site in Wilton, CT. It requires onsite presence to attend in\-person work\-related events, trainings and meetings and to further ensure teamwork, collaboration and innovation * A flexible workplace arrangement may be available to employees working in roles conducive to remote work (up to 2 days a week) **Role within Office** ---------------------- ### **Essential Job Functions** The essential job functions for this position include, but are not limited to: * Work in a fast\-paced office environment, including working in a standing or seated position for long periods sometimes exceeding 8 hours per day, 5 days per week * Commute to ASML’s facility and report to work on a regular and timely basis and complete the scheduled workday on a consistent basis * Routinely required to sit; walk; talk; hear; use hands to finger, handle and feel; stoop, kneel, crouch, twist, reach and stretch * Occasionally required to move around the campus * Perform office tasks using simple hand grasping, fine hand manipulation and reach associated with assigned tasks such as paperwork, computer keyboarding (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint), filing, calculating and use of telephone or other handheld electronic devices, continuously sometimes exceeding 8 hours per day, 5 days per week * Have a sufficient ability to communicate, through sight, hearing and/or otherwise, to perform assigned tasks and maintain proper job safety conditions * Occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds * Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus * Perform other functions that may be assigned ### **Additional Responsibilities (as needed in the cleanroom and/or labs):** * The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions * Must be willing to work in a clean room environment, wearing coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses and gloves.
