jobs.title: Senior GIS Programmer
jobs.description: **ASSYST** is seeking a **Senior GIS Programmer** to support the GIS modernization and integration efforts of our client in **Towson, Maryland (Hybrid 3 Days Onsite 2 Days Remote).** The role focuses on application development, ArcGIS Server environment support, legacy code modernization, and system integrations. **Key Responsibilities:** * Develop, maintain, and upgrade ArcGIS Server web applications and web services. * Support configuration efforts and web service integrations for Cityworks. * Repair and upgrade legacy Facilities and utility toolsets written in Visual C\# using Visual Studio 2010 (IDE) and the ArcObjects SDK 10\.1\. * Conduct root\-cause analysis on program and production issues. * Design and generate operational reports using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS). **Required Qualifications:** * Experience: 5\+ years of experience developing and modifying applications using C\#, JavaScript, Python, HTML, .NET, and J2EE. * Esri Stack: Hands\-on experience with ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS APIs (including JavaScript API), ArcGIS Web AppBuilder, Collector, ArcSDE, ArcGIS Mobile, and ModelBuilder. * Database \& Querying: Strong proficiency in SQL, triggers, stored procedures, and relational database management systems (SQL Server, Oracle preferred). * Reporting: Hands\-on experience developing reports using SSRS. * Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Business, or a related field. * 5\+ years of background in systems analysis, change management analysis, project management, or program analysis. * Recent experience supporting a state or local government entity. ASSYST is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, national origin or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law

No relocation is offered.** AT\&T is seeking an AI\-Native Software Engineer, Senior who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in AI\-enabled application development, agentic workflows, and enterprise system integration. In this role, you will build production\-grade applications, APIs, and intelligent workflow automations that help transform how work gets done across the enterprise. You will partner directly with business and technical stakeholders in a collaborative "2\-in\-a\-box" model, rapidly translating business needs into scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions. Success in this role requires a deep understanding of modern software engineering, practical experience applying Large Language Models (LLMs) and agent frameworks, and a passion for using AI to accelerate both software delivery and business outcomes. **What You'll Do** Build AI\-Powered Applications \& Agentic Workflows * Design, develop, and deploy AI\-enabled applications and intelligent workflow automations using modern LLM technologies. * Build and orchestrate agentic workflows leveraging frameworks such as LangGraph and similar orchestration platforms. * Develop multi\-step and multi\-agent solutions including routing, planning, tool utilization, workflow execution, and escalation patterns. * Implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, and context management strategies to improve AI accuracy and effectiveness. * Establish evaluation frameworks, testing methodologies, and release controls for AI\-enabled solutions. Engineer Enterprise\-Scale APIs \& Integrations * Design and build scalable backend services and APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django. * Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems, databases, event streams, and approved APIs. * Develop secure service contracts, validation frameworks, retry mechanisms, and observability capabilities. * Ensure enterprise\-grade security, governance, auditability, and access controls across all integrations. Deliver Full\-Stack Software Solutions * Develop end\-to\-end applications spanning backend services, data platforms, integrations, and user\-facing interfaces. * Build modern web experiences and workflow\-driven applications using contemporary front\-end technologies. * Collaborate with stakeholders to rapidly prototype, iterate, and productionize solutions that solve real business challenges. * Contribute to reusable platform components, libraries, and software assets that accelerate adoption across teams. Drive Operational Excellence * Apply secure\-by\-design principles including authentication, authorization, secrets management, and compliance\-aligned logging. * Implement automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, tracing, alerting, and performance optimization. * Ensure reliability through resilient system design patterns including retries, timeouts, rate limiting, and graceful degradation. * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, debugging, and delivery. Partner with the Business * Work directly with business leaders and stakeholders to understand objectives and translate requirements into technical solutions. * Communicate complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences and influence solution decisions. * Balance tradeoffs between speed, scale, cost, security, and maintainability. * Operate in a highly collaborative environment where business and engineering teams jointly own outcomes. **What You'll Need** Education * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production\-grade applications and services. * Experience building scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django. * Experience deploying and operating applications in cloud or enterprise environments. * Experience integrating enterprise systems through APIs, databases, event\-driven architectures, or service\-oriented platforms. * Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, containerization technologies, and automated testing frameworks. * Experience developing software solutions that leverage LLM capabilities and AI\-assisted workflows. Technical Skills * Strong software engineering fundamentals including system design, object\-oriented programming, data modeling, and architecture. * Proficiency in Python development and API design best practices. * Experience with relational databases, SQL, and modern data persistence technologies. * Understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and system reliability patterns. * Knowledge of software security, authentication, authorization, secrets manag \-Native Engineering Mindset * Demonstrated ability to use AI coding assistants and AI\-powered engineering tools to improve development velocity and software quality. * Experience building software solutions that responsibly incorporate LLM capabilities, structured prompting, tool calling, validation, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Knowledge of agent\-based architectures and workflow automation technologies. Advanced Technical Expertise * Hands\-on experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph or similar technologies. * Experience implementing RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, and AI grounding strategies. * Familiarity with workflow orchestration platforms such as Temporal, Airflow, Celery, or comparable solutions. * Experience with event\-driven architectures and messaging technologies such as Kafka or cloud\-native messaging services. * Knowledge of modern API gateways, OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and secure enterprise integration patterns. Leadership \& Collaboration * Ability to turn ambiguous business challenges into scalable technical solutions. * Strong problem\-solving skills and a bias toward execution and continuous improvement. * Experience working closely with business stakeholders in highly collaborative environments. * Passion for modern software engineering, AI innovation, and driving measurable business impact. **Why AT\&T?** This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI\-powered software engineering at enterprise scale. You'll work on high\-impact initiatives that combine modern software development, intelligent automation, and enterprise integration to transform the way work gets done. If you're passionate about building production\-grade systems, leveraging AI responsibly, and creating innovative solutions that deliver real business value, we'd love to hear from you. jobs.title: AI Led Forward Deployed Engineer | Design & Digital Products
jobs.description: **You are:** *As an AI led FDE , you embed with design \& product teams to originate, design, and ship AI\-powered digital products and experiences into production. You will build on top of enterprise data and technology foundations to create AI\-powered products that face customers, employees, and business users, driving revenue, engagement, and better decisions* ***The work:*** * Identify where AI creates measurable business value before a brief exists. Originate use cases, prioritize by impact, and shape the engagement. * Differentiate through a product\-led approach. Pair AI \& data depth with product strategy and product thinking, so the work ladders to a real product and its outcomes, not a proof of concept. * Bring fluency in the design\-to\-product pipeline. Move from insight and concept through design, prototype, and production the way Design \& Digital Products builds, connecting strategy directly to what ships. * Design and build AI systems end to end: RAG architecture, agentic orchestration, prompt \& context engineering, evals \& guardrails, tool\-use patterns, and MCP integration. * Select the right model and approach: frontier\-model selection, and when to apply fine\-tuning (LoRA / PEFT) vs. prompt engineering vs. RAG, exercising judgment over execution across cost, latency, accuracy, and compliance tradeoffs. * Activate AI within the client's existing enterprise data platforms. Connect AI products to where the data lives using data\-gravity patterns rather than re\-architecting infrastructure. * Build AI\-powered digital products and experiences full\-stack, with production accountability. Ship working code, not recommendations. * Deploy responsibly to production: MLOps, model serving, security, and cost / latency discipline at product level, with effective monitoring. * Codify best\-practice delivery patterns and feed field learnings back into the offering to make delivery repeatable. ***Basic Required Qualifications:*** * Minimum 3 years of AI \& Data experience, including solutioning, designing, or delivering AI \& Data projects, with hands\-on work shipping GenAI features (RAG, agentic workflows, evals and guardrails), not strategy decks alone. * Minimum 3 years of high\-value consulting experience, including large\-scale delivery with minimal oversight and proven ability to lead workstreams and meet deadlines, or relevant industry / functional experience. **Prefered Qualificaitions:** * Hands\-on delivery experience on at least one enterprise AI platform in production: AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, or Databricks Mosaic AI. * Working fluency with GenAI frameworks and patterns: LangChain or LlamaIndex, agentic orchestration (CrewAI / AutoGen), MCP, prompt and context engineering, and model selection across frontier and open\-weight models (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Llama, Mistral). * Model judgment: knows when to apply fine\-tuning (LoRA / PEFT) vs. prompt engineering vs. RAG, and can reason about cost, latency, accuracy, and compliance tradeoffs. * Product engineering ability: full\-stack build of AI\-powered digital products, ships working code, and can activate AI against existing enterprise data using data\-gravity patterns rather than re\-architecting infrastructure. * Product\-led mindset: connects AI \& data work to product strategy and the design\-to\-product pipeline, and can originate use cases and shape an engagement before a brief exists. * Experience managing senior stakeholders. * Strong program management and verbal and written communication skills. * Driven and entrepreneurial: ability to originate and shape new deals and lead go\-to\-market activities. * Excellent leadership and people skills: proven ability to build effective teams, foster collaboration and inclusion, and build strong relationships with stakeholders / clients. Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. You will build on top of enterprise data and technology foundations to create AI\-powered products that face customers, employees, and business users, driving revenue, engagement, and better decisions* ***The work:*** * Identify where AI creates measurable business value before a brief exists. Originate use cases, prioritize by impact, and shape the engagement. * Differentiate through a product\-led approach. Pair AI \& data depth with product strategy and product thinking, so the work ladders to a real product and its outcomes, not a proof of concept. * Bring fluency in the design\-to\-product pipeline. Move from insight and concept through design, prototype, and production the way Design \& Digital Products builds, connecting strategy directly to what ships. * Design and build AI systems end to end: RAG architecture, agentic orchestration, prompt \& context engineering, evals \& guardrails, tool\-use patterns, and MCP integration. * Select the right model and approach: frontier\-model selection, and when to apply fine\-tuning (LoRA / PEFT) vs. prompt engineering vs. RAG, exercising judgment over execution across cost, latency, accuracy, and compliance tradeoffs. * Activate AI within the client's existing enterprise data platforms. Connect AI products to where the data lives using data\-gravity patterns rather than re\-architecting infrastructure. * Build AI\-powered digital products and experiences full\-stack, with production accountability. Ship working code, not recommendations. * Deploy responsibly to production: MLOps, model serving, security, and cost / latency discipline at product level, with effective monitoring. * Codify best\-practice delivery patterns and feed field learnings back into the offering to make delivery repeatable. ***Basic Required Qualifications:*** * Minimum 3 years of AI \& Data experience, including solutioning, designing, or delivering AI \& Data projects, with hands\-on work shipping GenAI features (RAG, agentic workflows, evals and guardrails), not strategy decks alone. * Minimum 3 years of high\-value consulting experience, including large\-scale delivery with minimal oversight and proven ability to lead workstreams and meet deadlines, or relevant industry / functional experience. **Prefered Qualificaitions:** * Hands\-on delivery experience on at least one enterprise AI platform in production: AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, or Databricks Mosaic AI. * Working fluency with GenAI frameworks and patterns: LangChain or LlamaIndex, agentic orchestration (CrewAI / AutoGen), MCP, prompt and context engineering, and model selection across frontier and open\-weight models (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Llama, Mistral). * Model judgment: knows when to apply fine\-tuning (LoRA / PEFT) vs. prompt engineering vs. RAG, and can reason about cost, latency, accuracy, and compliance tradeoffs. * Product engineering ability: full\-stack build of AI\-powered digital products, ships working code, and can activate AI against existing enterprise data using data\-gravity patterns rather than re\-architecting infrastructure. * Product\-led mindset: connects AI \& data work to product strategy and the design\-to\-product pipeline, and can originate use cases and shape an engagement before a brief exists. * Experience managing senior stakeholders. * Strong program management and verbal and written communication skills. * Driven and entrepreneurial: ability to originate and shape new deals and lead go\-to\-market activities. * Excellent leadership and people skills: proven ability to build effective teams, foster collaboration and inclusion, and build strong relationships with stakeholders / clients. Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. jobs.description: **You are:** *As an AI led FDE , you embed with design \& product teams to originate, design, and ship AI\-powered digital products and experiences into production. You will build on top of enterprise data and technology foundations to create AI\-powered products that face customers, employees, and business users, driving revenue, engagement, and better decisions* ***The work:*** * Identify where AI creates measurable business value before a brief exists. Originate use cases, prioritize by impact, and shape the engagement. * Differentiate through a product\-led approach. Pair AI \& data depth with product strategy and product thinking, so the work ladders to a real product and its outcomes, not a proof of concept. * Bring fluency in the design\-to\-product pipeline. Move from insight and concept through design, prototype, and production the way Design \& Digital Products builds, connecting strategy directly to what ships. * Design and build AI systems end to end: RAG architecture, agentic orchestration, prompt \& context engineering, evals \& guardrails, tool\-use patterns, and MCP integration. * Select the right model and approach: frontier\-model selection, and when to apply fine\-tuning (LoRA / PEFT) vs. prompt engineering vs. RAG, exercising judgment over execution across cost, latency, accuracy, and compliance tradeoffs. * Activate AI within the client's existing enterprise data platforms. Connect AI products to where the data lives using data\-gravity patterns rather than re\-architecting infrastructure. * Build AI\-powered digital products and experiences full\-stack, with production accountability. Ship working code, not recommendations. * Deploy responsibly to production: MLOps, model serving, security, and cost / latency discipline at product level, with effective monitoring. * Codify best\-practice delivery patterns and feed field learnings back into the offering to make delivery repeatable. ***Basic Required Qualifications:*** * Minimum 3 years of AI \& Data experience, including solutioning, designing, or delivering AI \& Data projects, with hands\-on work shipping GenAI features (RAG, agentic workflows, evals and guardrails), not strategy decks alone. * Minimum 3 years of high\-value consulting experience, including large\-scale delivery with minimal oversight and proven ability to lead workstreams and meet deadlines, or relevant industry / functional experience. **Prefered Qualificaitions:** * Hands\-on delivery experience on at least one enterprise AI platform in production: AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, or Databricks Mosaic AI. * Working fluency with GenAI frameworks and patterns: LangChain or LlamaIndex, agentic orchestration (CrewAI / AutoGen), MCP, prompt and context engineering, and model selection across frontier and open\-weight models (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Llama, Mistral). * Model judgment: knows when to apply fine\-tuning (LoRA / PEFT) vs. prompt engineering vs. RAG, and can reason about cost, latency, accuracy, and compliance tradeoffs. * Product engineering ability: full\-stack build of AI\-powered digital products, ships working code, and can activate AI against existing enterprise data using data\-gravity patterns rather than re\-architecting infrastructure. * Product\-led mindset: connects AI \& data work to product strategy and the design\-to\-product pipeline, and can originate use cases and shape an engagement before a brief exists. * Experience managing senior stakeholders. * Strong program management and verbal and written communication skills. * Driven and entrepreneurial: ability to originate and shape new deals and lead go\-to\-market activities. * Excellent leadership and people skills: proven ability to build effective teams, foster collaboration and inclusion, and build strong relationships with stakeholders / clients. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with Adobe's Experience Intelligence team, you will compose, build, and deploy production\-grade AI systems. These systems power intelligent experiences across commercial and promotional activities. You will work on GenAI agents, predictive ML, retrieval and reasoning systems, and the platforms that support them at scale. Partnering with engineers, product managers, and business collaborators, you will turn emerging AI capabilities into reliable, scalable solutions that solve real\-world business problems. **Key Responsibilities:** Design, build, and deploy production\-grade AI systems, including GenAI agents, predictive ML, retrieval and reasoning systems, agent frameworks, tool calling, multi\-agent workflows, APIs, and data pipelines, with a strong focus on quality, scalability, reliability, and performance. Develop AI/ML solutions over large\-scale structured and unstructured enterprise data, including evaluation frameworks and techniques to continuously improve accuracy and user experience. Own solutions end\-to\-end, from architecture and experimentation through implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Partner closely with product managers and collaborators to identify high\-value problems and integrate AI capabilities into real\-world sales and marketing workflows. Identify and prototype emerging AI opportunities, turning new technologies and ideas into differentiated, production\-ready capabilities. **What You Need to Succeed:** MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5\+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning, GenAI, NLP, retrieval, or related AI systems. Strong understanding of modern LLM and agentic AI technologies, including RAG, tool/function calling, reasoning, evaluation, and context management. Strong foundation in machine learning, predictive modeling, statistics, and techniques for working with large\-scale structured and unstructured data. Strong software engineering skills, including Python, data structures and algorithms, system design, testing, code quality, and production debugging. Experience building production AI/ML services using technologies such as PyTorch, REST APIs, Docker, data/orchestration pipelines, and cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS. Experience designing scalable and reliable AI systems and evaluating them across quality, latency, cost, and operational performance. Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams in a fast\-paced environment. jobs.description: AdvanSix plays a critical role in global supply chains, innovating and delivering essential products for our customers in a wide variety of end markets and applications that touch people’s lives, such as building and construction, fertilizers, plastics, solvents, packaging, paints, coatings, adhesives, and electronics. Our reliable and sustainable supply of quality products emerges from the vertically integrated value chain of our three U.S. based manufacturing facilities. AdvanSix strives to deliver best\-in\-class customer experiences and differentiated products in the industries of nylon solutions, chemical intermediates, and plant nutrients, guided by our core values of Safety, Integrity, Accountability and Respect. Please view a short video about our company here, AdvanSix Video. The Automation and Process Control Engineer will also implement and maintain add\-on automation enhancements such as APC, alarm management and monitoring, control loop tuning software, and control process monitoring. This position is located at the AdvanSix Hopewell, VA site and reports through the Technical Services department. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Design and implement control system configuration for changes and new installations in Honeywell Experion and Fisher Provox environments * Proactively work with operations areas to develop and implement control improvements for the purposes of reducing cost, increasing productivity, mitigating/reducing safety and environmental concerns, and enhancing operator interfaces with the control system * Troubleshooting of process control issues including configuration, interlocking, and network communication issues * Develop and implement HMI graphics that enable efficient operator response and increase operator process knowledge * Provide leadership and technical support for ensuring that all the control applications used in the plant are fully aligned with the manufacturing strategies. This support encompasses all BPCS and advanced applications * Support capital project process in development of automation and process control scope * Planning and execution of short\-term and long\-term activities required to effectively use advanced control applications in the manufacturing plants \- includes hands\-on work on selection, design, configuration, performance measurement, upgrades, troubleshooting and optimization * Design, use, update, and maintenance of technical documentation for automation and process control standards * Close collaboration with other automation and process control engineers and the IT OT engineers for effective implementation and maintenance of the process control system * Train process and production engineers on basic control and HMI configuration * Ensure that control software and hardware is up\-to\-date and meets plant site requirements **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related degree with process control experience required * 5\+ years of chemical process manufacturing, or related, experience required * Proven track record of implementing, improving, and supporting automation and process control systems, preferably including experience with Honeywell Experion * Strong track record of process troubleshooting and problem solving * Ability to provide off\-hours, on\-call support via a rotating schedule * Good interpersonal and communication skills for developing collaborative working relationships with internal AdvanSix employees as well as jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Aeroflow Health – Data Engineer** Aeroflow Health is a national leader in home medical equipment and clinical services. We combine technology, operational excellence, and compassionate expertise to deliver essential products and care directly to patients’ homes. At Aeroflow Health, we make healthcare accessible by taking a holistic approach to how we care for our patients. We are equally passionate about taking care of our employees. Recognized as one of the fastest\-growing healthcare companies in the U.S., an Inc. 5000 honoree, and a certified Great Place to Work®, Aeroflow continues to seek ways to be one of the nation’s top employers. As we continue to grow, we remain committed to building an exceptional workplace where talented professionals are empowered, supported, and inspired to make a meaningful impact every day. **The Opportunity** Within Aeroflow, the **SQL Engineering team** builds and supports the databases, data pipelines, and application logic that power critical operational workflows across the organization. Our environment combines deeply established Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) systems with a growing AWS cloud ecosystem. As Aeroflow continues to scale, the team is focused not only on supporting today’s environment, but also on thoughtfully modernizing how our data systems are built, deployed, and maintained for the future. We are looking for a hands\-on **Data Engineer** who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, writing and optimizing production SQL, improving existing systems, and partnering directly with both technical teams and business stakeholders. This is an **engineering\-focused position rather than a reporting, BI, or analytics\-focused role**. While every week will look a little different, you can expect the role to be approximately **60% hands\-on SQL/AWS engineering, 20% business and technical partnership, and 20% code review and engineering collaboration.** This position works on a **hybrid schedule, three days per week in the office.** **Your Primary Responsibilities:** **Hands\-on Data \& SQL Engineering:** * Design, develop, and maintain reliable SQL\-based solutions that support critical operational and application workflows. * Write and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, data models, and production database logic. * Troubleshoot, optimize, and refactor existing SQL code and legacy processes to improve performance, reliability, and maintainability. * Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and workflows across established database systems and modern AWS environments. * Navigate complex integrations and data dependencies across multiple systems and business functions. * Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, automate manual processes, and thoughtfully modernize legacy solutions. **Business \& Technical Partnership** * Partner directly with business and technical stakeholders to understand the problem behind the request—not simply execute against a ticket. * Translate business requirements into practical, maintainable engineering solutions. * Ask thoughtful questions, uncover dependencies and constraints, and help stakeholders understand technical tradeoffs. * Collaborate closely with Application Engineering, Analytics, and other technology teams to deliver solutions that work effectively across systems and business functions. **Engineering Quality \& Team Contribution** * Review code and collaborate with other engineers to improve quality, consistency, performance, and maintainability. * Apply sound technical judgment when balancing scalability, reliability, complexity, performance, and business needs. * Develop and maintain clear technical documentation for database architecture, workflows, and engineering processes. * Contribute as a hands\-on individual engineer while sharing knowledge and helping strengthen engineering practices across the team. * Maintain HIPAA/patient confidentiality and comply with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies. * Compliance is a condition of employment and is considered an element of job performance. * Maintain regular and reliable attendance as assigned by your schedule. * Perform other job duties as assigned. **Skills for Success** * **Strong SQL engineering instincts:** Understand how database design, query structure, indexing, and application behavior affect performance and reliability. * **Analytical problem\-solving:** Enjoy digging into complicated problems, tracing dependencies, identifying root causes, and improving systems rather than simply treating symptoms. * **Pragmatic technical judgment:** Distinguish meaningful engineering improvements from unnecessary complexity and clearly explain the tradeoffs behind your recommendations. * **Systems thinking:** Understand how databases, applications, infrastructure, integrations, and business processes interact rather than viewing SQL in isolation. * **Business curiosity:** Ask questions, understand the underlying business problem, and he ipating in or leading a migration from a legacy database or technology stack to a modern architecture or cloud environment. * Deeper hands\-on experience with AWS services such as S3, RDS, Glue, Athena, or related technologies. * Experience with Python, Bash, or another scripting language used for automation or data engineering. * Experience with orchestration or transformation tools such as Apache Airflow or dbt. * Experience with source control, automated testing, or CI/CD practices for database and data engineering changes. * Experience supporting mission\-critical, healthcare, or other regulated production environments requiring strong availability, security, disaster recovery, or audit discipline. **What We Look For** We are looking for highly motivated, talented engineers who measure success by the reliability of the systems they build and the business problems they help solve. You should: * Be naturally curious and willing to dig beneath the initial request to understand the real problem that needs to be solved. * Take ownership of your work and be comfortable operating with autonomy while knowing when to collaborate or ask for input. * Care about writing maintainable, reliable, and testable code—not simply getting something to work. * Enjoy improving existing systems and processes rather than requiring a perfect greenfield environment. * Bring a practical, thoughtful approach to modernization and recognize when newer technology adds meaningful value. * Be comfortable working directly with stakeholders and asking questions rather than relying exclusively on tickets or predefined requirements. * Be collaborative, coachable, and willing to both give and receive thoughtful technical feedback. * Leave systems, processes, and teams stronger than you found them. **What Aeroflow Offers** **What Aeroflow Offers** Competitive Pay, Health Plans with FSA or HSA options, Dental, and Vision Insurance, Optional Life Insurance, 401K with Company Match, 12 weeks of parental leave for birthing parent/ 4 weeks leave for non\-birthing parent(s), Additional Parental benefits to include fertility stipends, free diapers, breast pump, Paid Holidays, PTO Accrual from day one, Employee Assistance Programs and SO MUCH MORE!! Here at Aeroflow, we are proud of our commitment to all of our employees. Aeroflow Health has been recognized both locally and nationally for the following achievements: * **Family Forward Certified** * **Great Place to Work Certified** * **Inc. 5000 Best Place to Work award winner** * **HME Excellence Award** * **Sky High Growth Award** If you’ve been looking for an opportunity that will allow you to make an impact, and an organization with unlimited growth potential, we want to hear from you! Aeroflow Health is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. We value transparency and candidate safety throughout the hiring process. Aeroflow recruiters may reach out through platforms such as LinkedIn or Indeed; however, all interviews and/or offer coordination and sensitive information requests will occur only through our official communication channels. You will never be asked to provide personal data outside our secure application portal, and all interview or offer details will come from an @aeroflowinc.com email address. We do not conduct interviews via text message or instant\-messaging apps. jobs.title: Service Desk Senior Engineer
jobs.description: At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone. AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees' work\-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in\-person at an AlixPartners office and remote work. **Location**: Chicago, IL **What you'll do** In this role on AlixPartners' Corporate Services Information Technology team, a successful Service Desk Senior Engineer will work on the IT Service Desk to provide a high level of customer service and software/hardware problem resolution. This will be achieved by performing in depth diagnosis and guiding users through step\-by\-step solutions to ensure a successful outcome when fielding calls from the user base, creating the initial record of the request and resolving all Level One/Level Two end\-user problems over the phone or in\-person. We seek a highly organized, detail\-oriented person who can work independently and manage multiple projects with competing priorities. Clear communication, teamwork and professionalism are key core values that this candidate would need to display. The Service Desk Senior Engineer is in Chicago, IL, reporting to the Service Desk Lead. Paid relocation is not available. Core working hours are 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Central, Monday – Friday. * Handle incoming IT queries from end users via phone, email, chat, and walk\-up, triaging and managing the flow of requests. Question users effectively to establish the full scope of the issue and log it accurately in ServiceNow * Provide hands\-on audio\-visual support for conference rooms, town halls, board meetings, and client\-facing events, both on and off site. This includes setting up, testing, and actively monitoring high\-profile meetings; supporting Zoom and Microsoft Teams Rooms, displays, microphones, cameras, and wireless presentation systems; troubleshooting live during sessions; and coordinating with vendors on AV faults and room refreshes * Resolve Level 1 and Level 2 issues directly — in person, via remote access, or by guiding the user through the fix themselves * Maintain detailed ticket records and knowledge base articles, using issue history and trend data to identify recurring problems and recommend preventative fixes * Escalate requests that cannot be resolved by the Service Desk to other IT teams, and contact third\-party vendors for warranty service repair as necessary * Act as a dedicated point of contact for executive and VIP users, including the C\-suite and their assistants — providing white\-glove, deskside and remote support, proactive device and meeting readiness checks, and discreet handling of sensitive issues with a high sense of urgency * Maintain and ensure accuracy of all asset information for all PC's, local/networked printers, monitors and defined peripherals * Administer mobile devices and MDM, including iOS/iPadOS and Microsoft Intune * Diagnose and resolve end\-user network or local printer problems, PC hardware problems, e\-mail, Internet, VPN, and local\-area network access problems * Coordinate timely repair of PC computer equipment covered by third\-party vendor maintenance agreements * Participate and assist in office moves and changes * Active involvement in the IT department and its projects, providing feedback/ideas as appropriate * Additional responsibilities as identified; this description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities **What you'll bring** * Minimum three (3\) years of experience in a similar service desk or deskside support role * Experience with ServiceNow ITSM — incident, request, and problem management, working queues to SLA, and building or maintaining knowledge base articles * Experience with Microsoft 365 applications, PC's, Windows 11, associated software, printers, and networking * Hands\-on experience supporting macOS in an enterprise environment, including Jamf\-managed devices, macOS imaging/enrolment, and iOS/iPadOS; beneficial to have worked in an ITIL based environment * Experience working a shared ticket queue to SLA as part of a larger support team * Certification in at least one technical product * Proven track record supporting senior executives / C\-suite users in a professional services or similarly demanding environment, with the poise, discretion, and confidentiality that audience requires * Highly effective customer service and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate and influence across teams, functions, and seniority levels, including partnering effectively with senior leaders. * Excellent organizational skills with experience operating in time\-sensitive environment, balancing competing priorities with sound judgment and discretion. * Comfortable leveraging firm\-approved AI tools and technology to support day\-to\-day work efficiencies, streamline tasks, and enhance productivity. * Experience identifying and driving process, tool, or system improvements to enhance efficiency, quality, or scalability. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (other languages useful), with the ability to deliver clear, concise, and executive\-ready messaging. * Ability to work independently and within a team in high pressure situations; willing to learn; adaptable with a "can do" attitude * Ability to lift 50 pounds * Occasional travel, less than 5% of time * Core working hours are 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Central, Monday – Friday, based in the Chicago office. The Service Desk operates staggered shifts to maintain coverage across U.S. time zones, and this role may be assigned to an earlier or later shift on rotation. Willingness to work outside of normal U.S. business hours for maintenance windows, escalations, and unique project needs is required. * Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday. * Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners' Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization. *MUST BE CURRENTLY AUTHORIZED TO WORK IN THE UNITED STATES. (e.g., H\-1B, STEM OPT, TN, etc.)* The firm offers a comprehensive benefits program including health, vision, dental, disability, 401K, tuition reimbursement, identity theft protection, and mental wellness support. Employees will also receive a generous paid leave policy including vacation/personal time starting at 7\.34 hours per pay period, sick time up to 80 hours annually, parental leave, and twelve holidays. *The salary range for this role takes into account a number of factors and is between $75,000/annually \- $90,000/annually with eligibility for an annual discretionary bonus.* *AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Software Engineer – Enterprise Applications
jobs.description: **Company Overview** *ACS (Allen Control Systems) is a defense technology company building precision robotic systems for the United States and its allies. Founded by two former U.S. Navy electrical engineers with deep experience in robotics and software, ACS brings together AI, computer vision, precision motion, and advanced hardware to solve complex defense challenges across land, air, and maritime environments.* *Our flagship product, Bullfrog, is an autonomous precision weapon system that transforms existing weapons into highly accurate counter\-drone systems — giving warfighters a scalable, cost\-effective response to one of the fastest\-growing threats on the modern battlefield. Bullfrog is deployed with U.S. forces, and ACS works with organizations throughout the U.S. military and national security community.* *Following a $200 million Series B at a $2\.2 billion valuation, ACS is rapidly expanding manufacturing, accelerating Bullfrog deployments, and developing the next generation of autonomous battlefield systems. This is an opportunity to join a proven, fast\-moving team and help scale technology with direct, real\-world impact on national security.* *ACS is headquartered in Austin, Texas, with additional operations in Alexandria, Virginia; Mountain View, California; and Huntsville, Alabama. For more information, visit* *allencontrolsystems.com**.* **Position Overview:** We are seeking a motivated **Software Engineer I/II to join our Enterprise Applications team.** In this role, you will help develop, enhance, and support internal and business\-facing applications that enable critical operations across the organization. maintain database queries, application logic, APIs, and user interfaces. * Participate in code reviews, testing, sprint planning, and other Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) activities. * Create and maintain technical documentation for applications, integrations, and development processes. * Learn and apply software engineering best practices related to testing, security, performance, and maintainability. * Collaborate with more experienced engineers and contribute ideas for improving applications and development processes. **What You'll Need:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL, including writing SQL queries. * Familiarity with REST APIs and basic application integration concepts. * Experience using version control tools such as Git. * Understanding of fundamental software development concepts, including testing, debugging, object\-oriented programming, and source control. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with an eagerness to learn new technologies. * Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with both technical and non\-technical team members. **You'll Stand Out:** * Internship, academic, or professional experience developing business or enterprise applications. * Exposure to ERP, CRM, manufacturing, workflow automation, or other enterprise systems. * Experience with Python and PostgreSQL. * Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps concepts. * Experience working with APIs or integrating multiple applications. * Familiarity with Docker or containerized applications. * Basic understanding of application security concepts such as authentication, authorization, and data protection. * Experience working in an Agile or Scrum development environment. * Interest in learning how software supports business processes across areas such as manufacturing, supply chain, finance, engineering, and operations. **Leveling** This position may be hired as a Software Engineer I or Software Engineer II depending on the candidate's experience and demonstrated technical capabilities. * **Software Engineer I** knowledge. * **Software Engineer II** candidates are expected to demonstrate greater independence in developing, troubleshooting, and delivering software solutions and may take ownership of smaller applications, integrations, or technical workstreams. **What We Offer:** * Competitive salary * ACS Equity Package * Health, Dental, Vision Insurance * Paid Time Off *Allen Control Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Allen Control Systems prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

This is a large, live production system serving millions of customers, not a greenfield build. You will provide full\-stack technical leadership, balancing a major architectural transformation (agents replacing dashboards as the primary interface) with the stability and reliability that our existing customer base depends on. You will diagnose deep systemic problems, shape product direction, define multi\-year technical strategy, and drive execution across teams — all while operating at a scale where correctness and performance directly determine customer trust. You will also drive the modernization of how the team builds software — advancing AI\-native engineering practices including AI\-assisted development, automated testing, and LLM\-driven code generation. This role requires a leader who thrives in ambiguity, can move fluidly between low\-level system diagnosis and high\-level architectural vision, and has a proven track record of evolving large\-scale production systems without disrupting the customers who rely on them. Within Quick, Amazon QuickSight powers the structured data and business intelligence layer: the semantic models, query engine, and governed enterprise data that AI agents reason over. At the center of this transformation is the structured data stack — connectivity and connectors, query engine, semantic layer, and the agents that operate across every layer. jobs.title: SDE II, EC2 Instance Networking, EC2 Nitro
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Do you want to build the networking infrastructure that powers every virtual machine in the world's largest cloud? Are you excited by the challenge of writing systems software that runs on millions custom networking cards across millions of hosts? The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\) Instance Networking team builds and operates the software\-defined networking stack at the heart of AWS. Our code is what makes Virtual Private Clouds (VPC) work, what enforces customer security policies, and what enables workloads to scale from a single instance to clusters of tens of thousands. Every packet that enters or leaves an EC2 instance flows through software we write, running on custom silicon designed in\-house. This work sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and the AI revolution. As machine learning workloads grow to unprecedented scale \- training runs spanning thousands of accelerators, clusters demanding millions of network endpoints, and fabrics pushing hundreds of gigabits per second. We build the networking primitives that make these workloads possible: high\-performance interfaces, low\-latency data plane protocols, and scalable network virtualization that operates predictably even under heavy churn. When the world's most ambitious AI companies scale on AWS, they're relying on the software we build. You'll write low\-level systems code in C and Rust running on custom hardware in a real\-time embedded environment. You'll work on network virtualization protocols, packet processing pipelines, and availability mechanisms that must perform correctly at massive scale with sub\-second latency requirements. You'll solve problems that span hardware, firmware, and software, and see the direct impact of your work on customers running some of the largest and most demanding workloads in the cloud. jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, AWS Discounts
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The AWS Bill Generation \- Discounts team is at the heart of how AWS rewards customer loyalty and drives long\-term infrastructure commitments. We own and operate the billing systems that compute all discount\-based derived line items for AWS customers worldwide — including Usage Based Discounts (UBD), Private Rate Card discounts (Flat PRC and Tiered UBTD), Cross\-Service Discounts (CSD), Prepayment Discounts (DV), and Volume discounts (VPA). Our discounts are applied at both the service level (Service Specific Discount \- SSD) and at granular service attribute levels (Attribute Based Discount \- ABD), and are delivered through both Out\-of\-Cycle (OCB) and Anniversary bills. We also own CBAS (Config\-Based Billing Automation System) — a solution we built to operationalize our largest and most complex customer contracts — and are actively driving its migration to scalable, standard discounting infrastructure. Our work directly impacts AWS's ability to close enterprise deals, retain strategic customers, and scale discount programs without engineering bottlenecks. As a Software Development Engineer on the Discounts team, you will design, build, and operate systems at the intersection of enterprise contracts, pricing flexibility, and billing accuracy. You will own components end to end and contribute to our roadmap focused on: * Flexibility \& Time to Market — Building configuration\-based billing infrastructure (BCD) that decouples discount definition from execution, enabling new pricing constructs to go live in days rather than months, and enabling complex discounts for strategic AI partnerships like Anthropic and OpenAI * Architectural Simplification — Consolidating Bill Compute tasks, and eliminating manual bill generation SOPs through automation * Customer Delight — Improving discount transparency, standardizing benefit\-sharing features across regions, and reducing customer contacts related to discount charges * Operational Sustainability — Reducing Sev2s, accelerating deployment cycles through CI/CD, and leveraging AI to enhance builder productivity Key job responsibilities * Design and build distributed systems that apply discount logic at AWS scale — processing billions of usage events and generating discount line items across UBD, PRC, ABD, CSD, EDP, and other discount mechanisms * Build configuration\-driven discount systems that allow sales, service, and finance teams to structure new discount constructs without requiring engineering changes * Enforce accuracy as a non\-negotiable bar — every discount must be correctly applied, fully auditable, and traceable from contract terms to invoice line item * Partner with AWS sales, finance, and service teams (EC2, Marketplace, Bedrock, APN) to translate complex enterprise deal structures into scalable, durable billing constructs * Mentor engineers and raise the bar for code quality, operational excellence, and engineering rigor across the team A day in the life Collaborate with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market. * Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry. * Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed. * Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault\-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use. * Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems. * Work in an agile environment to deliver high\-quality software. About the team The AWS Bill Generation \- Discounts team is at the heart of how AWS rewards customer loyalty and drives long\-term infrastructure commitments. We own and operate the billing systems that compute all discount\-based derived line items for AWS customers worldwide — including Usage Based Discounts (UBD), Private Rate Card discounts (Flat PRC and Tiered UBTD), Cross\-Service Discounts (CSD), Prepayment Discounts (DV), and Volume discounts (VPA). Our discounts are applied at both the service level (Service Specific Discount \- SSD) and at granular service attribute levels (Attribute Based Discount \- ABD), and are delivered through both Out\-of\-Cycle (OCB) and Anniversary bills. We also own CBAS (Config\-Based Billing Automation System) — a solution we built to operationalize our largest and most complex customer contracts — and are actively driving its migration to scalable, standard discounting infrastructure. Our work directly impacts AWS's ability to close enterprise deals, retain strategic customers, and scale discount programs without engineering bottlenecks.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, GCNA-D Edge
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Global Connectivity and Network Availability (GCNA) is the backbone that connects the global AWS network. It is dedicated to controlling the internet traffic that allows users to access their information and applications regardless of where they are in the world. GCNA is responsible for building and designing a complex backbone network that allows internet traffic to flow efficiently between Data Centers and customers. The ideal candidate will share our excitement about cloud computing and will be passionate about delivering high quality services. You will have good knowledge of distributed systems with design and implementation experience, as well as the ability to lead and mentor other engineers. You will be customer centric and enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment that requires excellent technical and communication skills. You will join a tenured team of Network Development Engineers and Software Development Engineers. This is an opportunity to build a new service utilizing AWS technologies. We are looking for a candidate who will be comfortable working with a broad range of data sources and solving problems at scale. As a team we proactively support knowledge\-sharing and we embrace opportunities to teach company\-wide. Since every business at Amazon relies on a network that runs smoothly, the right candidate will guide the business and communicate value, work collaboratively to develop pragmatic yet flexible solutions and move forward in the face ambiguity. The candidate should be willing to build good working relationships within the team and across AWS. Working at AWS on the GCNA Team Key job responsibilities As a Software Development Engineer, you will oversee the complete software development lifecycle: * Defining, prioritizing, designing, building, and testing new features. * Operate an AWS business with globally distributed servers and customers at a massive scale. * Understand what it takes to grow and operate a global business at our scale. A day in the life As a Software Development Engineer, you will problem\-solve and innovate in an agile, sometimes ambiguous environment. You will build creative short\-term and sustainable long\-term solutions with others as passionate as you about this mission. You will use data to make decisions and validate assumptions. You will learn from others and help grow those in your team to achieve their best. About the team GCNA\-D provides high\-performing Internet connectivity for a wide range of use cases, such as retail (amazon.com), video streaming (Prime Video), content delivery (CloudFront), DNS (Route53\), AWS services (such as EC2/S3\), consumer devices (such as FireTV/Kindle/Echo), and more. Within AWS Networking, the GCNA\-D organization is responsible for connecting Amazon to the global Internet. With connections to thousands of unique external networks in hundreds of locations across the world, our mission is to deliver an Internet connectivity experience that sets the global standard for performance, availability, security, and cost, making Amazon the clear choice for our customers’ needs. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Manager, AWS IoT (Physical AI)
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use. AWS IoT is building the infrastructure to deliver AI from the cloud to the physical world. The Physical AI team develops services that provision, deploy, monitor, and secure AI software across processors inside autonomous machines, including robots, vehicles, drones, agricultural equipment, and industrial workcells, operating in environments with limited or no cloud connectivity. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to build and lead the team behind edge\-first fleet management for Physical AI. Your team owns software that runs on embedded processors inside autonomous machines and the cloud control plane that orchestrates them, coordinating deployments across hierarchical, heterogeneous processor topologies that often operate entirely offline. You will lead engineers writing production C\+\+ and Rust for local artifact caching, cryptographic verification, peer discovery over link\-local networks, and coordinated over\-the\-air updates across nested processor hierarchies, and you will own the cloud services that track fleet state when the fleet is not reachable. Physical AI is a new business for AWS, so you will define the platform while you build it, hire the team that builds it, and decide what the team does not build. This is a rare chance to lead where cloud services meet physical machines, shipping software that keeps autonomous systems running safely in the real world. The Physical AI team within AWS IoT is focused on delivering intelligence to every processor inside autonomous machines at scale. We build the services that provision, deploy, and secure AI software across robots, vehicles, drones, and industrial equipment worldwide. Our work sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and embedded systems, and we partner closely with other AWS IoT teams to push what is possible in disconnected, resource\-constrained environments. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every engineer's voice matters and new ideas are welcomed. Key job responsibilities Lead a team of cloud and embedded engineers building the edge runtime and control plane for Physical AI fleet management, including artifact caching, peer discovery, coordinated OTA across nested processor hierarchies, and fleet state reconciliation after long disconnection. Hire, develop, and retain engineers from L4 through L6, and build a team where cloud engineers ramp on embedded systems and embedded engineers ramp on distributed systems. Own the roadmap from ambiguous problem statements through launch, and scale the platform from early adopters to global fleets of autonomous machines across every AWS region. Drive deployment reliability on hardware that is physically accessible and routinely offline, where a failed update reaches machines that move and rollback has to work without a network round trip. Own the security architecture for software and model distribution, including signed artifacts, secure OTA (TUF and Uptane), and hardware root of trust (TPM, secure boot, attestation) on devices an attacker can hold. Own operational excellence for physical fleets, including oncall, alarming, release discipline, and the version and security posture of every processor in the field. Partner with client teams across AWS IoT, applied science, and robotics, and with silicon and OEM partners whose attestation and boot primitives the security model depends on. Set the technical bar through architecture and design review, and hold decisions on state, consistency, and failure handling across tiers that cannot see each other. A day in the life You might start your morning reviewing a design for coordinated OTA across nested processors and pushing back on how it handles a gateway that reconnects with stale state. After standup you could run a hiring loop debrief, then meet a silicon partner to close an attestation dependency that gates the next release. In the afternoon you might sit with two engineers to cut the scope of a workstream that is trending late, write the update that tells your leadership why, and end the day with real autonomous hardware to see what the fleet actually reports. About the team ABOUT AWS: Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed i es, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of engineering team management experience * 7\+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience * 3\+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations * Experience partnering with product or program management teams * Experience with systems software, embedded Linux, or software that ships to devices **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers * Experience managing teams that own both cloud services and embedded or on\-device layers * Experience with edge AI and ML inference deployment, including model compatibility and versioning at fleet scale * Experience with secure OTA architecture (TUF, Uptane) and hardware root of trust (TPM, HSM, secure boot, attestation) * Experience with AWS IoT, AWS IoT Greengrass, or other cloud\-based device management services Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager - Open Source, Kiro
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Kiro Labs is the public home for community\-built projects in the Kiro ecosystem \- a GitHub organization where Amazon engineers, and over time trusted external contributors, publish the experimental tools, SDKs, MCP servers, CLI extensions, and skill libraries they build on top of Kiro. Thousands of engineers already build for Kiro every day. Almost none of that work has left the building. Kiro Labs is how we open it up: a governed but deliberately low\-friction path that moves internal innovation into the open, where a broader community of developers can find it, use it, and build on it. We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to build that program. You'll own the mechanisms that turn Kiro Labs from a promising side effort into a durable, scalable incubator: the publishing pipeline, the governance model, the lifecycle, and the metrics. You'll be the connective tissue across the Kiro product team, open source strategy, security, legal, marketing, and customer success \- diving deep enough technically to understand what contributors are building, and program\-managing well enough to get it shipped and keep the org healthy. Key job responsibilities \- Own the publishing pipeline end to end \- Design and run the intake process that takes a project from proposal to public repo fit review, security review, license and trademark review, and repo creation \- and relentlessly drive down time\-to\-publish. \- Build the governance model \- Stand up the review committee, define the fit, quality, and security bar, establish decision rights and response SLAs, and document the entire workflow. \- Manage cross\-functional dependencies and unblock contributors \- Coordinate across product, open source strategy, security, legal/IP, marketing, and customer success. Own the critical path, clear blockers, and give contributors a single, obvious place to get answers. \- Own project lifecycle and org health \- Define and operate the active, maintenance, and archived states, health monitoring, and the sunset process, so Kiro Labs stays a curated set of working tools rather than a graveyard of abandoned repos. \- Define and report on success \- Establish the program's KPIs \- projects published, external engagement (stars, forks, issues, and PRs from outside Amazon), projects that graduate to broad adoption, time\-to\-publish, and growth in external awareness of Kiro and report progress, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership. \- Scale the operation \- Introduce automated quality and health checks, write the SOPs, and reduce manual effort so the program runs on mechanisms About the team Kiro Labs sits at the intersection of product, customer success, engineering, and open source for Kiro. It's the external\-facing complement to a thriving internal builder culture: the place where the tools Amazon engineers build on Kiro reach a public audience, and where a nascent external community can start to form around the product. This role brings together partners who have each carried a piece of it \- open source strategy, the Kiro product team, marketing, and customer success \- under a single program owner accountable for making it work. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience * 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience * Experience managing programs across cross\-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules * Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience developing and implementing KPI goals and strategies based on broader organization goals * 3\+ years of software development experience, or Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent * Experience running open source or developer community programs, including GitHub organization administration, open source release and compliance processes, and open source licensing Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. How would you like to be a part of Earth’s most customer\-centric company? You would work with teams of front\-line responders who support the operations of some of the world’s most powerful data centers. Our Data Center Engineering Operations team maintain and operate our critical infrastructure systems so that they are prepared to stand up against any situation. AWS has the world’s largest cloud computing portfolio. As an Amazonian you will work in some of the most sophisticated, safe, and secure data centers in the world. Our Chief Engineers (CE) help keep them that way by working with the brightest minds from around the globe to help test and implement the newest technology and work practices to meet the demands of a changing market. We have a passion for learning and evolving, it’s how we have helped define ourselves as leaders in the industry. Let’s work hard, have fun, and make history! Key job responsibilities * Act as the primary escalation point for all facilities\-related issues. Oversee operation and management of routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc. * Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures, and troubleshooting of facility within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA). * Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and responsible for working with Facility Manager (FM) to set team culture. * Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams \- May assist in the build out of new facilities and assist in projects to increase current facility efficiency \- Working outside of normal business hours for routine maintenance as required, including responding to out\-of\-hours emergency calls. \- Communicate complex technical information to a non\-technical audience. \- Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency \- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff * Establish building performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility operations and maintenance. * Utilize Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook and other basic administrative tools to perform day to day tasks Physical Requirements: Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations: * Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently * Participate in group lifts for 40\+ pounds * Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder * Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position * Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection A day in the life This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands\-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission\-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment that supports servers that must maintain better than 99\.999% uptime. Equipment will include but is not limited to stand\-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment. The CE directs, trains and supports technicians in their role of providing hands\-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment\-specific training exercises is also expected. They manage projects from conception to completion. These projects involve independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities.
