jobs.title: Test Set Design Engineer I
jobs.description: **Job Description** At BAE Systems, we promote a strong, collaborative culture and provide our employees with the tools, skills and training they need to succeed. We are all about trust, camaraderie, and a shared mission on delivering world class products to our commercial and military customers. We offer a flexible hybrid work environment and 9/80 work schedule. Our company is part of the community, drives to improve our future, and protects our freedom. Are you a recent Electrical graduate with a couple of engineering internship experiences looking for the next step to grow your career? Do you want to design and test hardware that really matters and be a part of a cause greater than yourself? Then, help us protect those that protect us by maintaining vital defense products and developing Next Generation Electronic Systems Products and Solutions. We need your talent, motivation, and vision to join our growing teams. BAE Systems has recently been awarded new programs and is currently undergoing an exciting period of growth. As a Test Equipment Design Engineer, you will develop, upgrade, and maintain systems for testing products that support military and commercial aircraft and ground vehicles. You will join a cross\-functional group of professionals that are responsible for all aspects of test systems development including mechanical, electrical, software and fabrication. With our team, you will have the opportunity to utilize and develop your skills in a fast paced and exciting environment for a broad range of test systems from simple circuit card testers to very large and complex systems integration labs. We are looking for an Engineer with practical design, simulation, and integration experience to add to our team. This is an exciting opportunity to develop test systems to support products for some of the world’s most advanced military aircraft, sea, and ground vehicles. **In this Test Equipment Design Engineer position, you will make impacts in the following ways:** * Perform technical work that requires the application of engineering principles, theories, concepts, and techniques for the development of Test Equipment used to support the verification and acceptance testing of electronic assemblies and systems of varying technologies. * Consult with engineering specialists to devise new techniques and approaches and provide solutions to a wide range of technical problems dealing with the selection, design, and implementation of test strategies in support of acceptance and performance test methodologies. Make independent decisions based on available data, selection of materials and required parameters. * Work from technical objectives, overall schedules and expected results as specified by supervisor or senior engineering personnel. Support project segments for achievement of schedule, fiscal and technical performance objectives. * Support assignments that are broad and may include: + design and development of new test techniques + investigate and develop solutions for vital legacy test equipment + design and development of test plans, procedures, test strategies, and test requirements of company products + design and development of manual and automated test equipment + testing and integration of procedures, initial prototype equipment and systems integration support * Support a Senior engineer to complete tasks in a timely and cost\-effective manner. * Prepare charts, diagrams and reports expressing recommendations, technical accomplishments and project progress measured against specific plans. **Required Education, Experience, \& Skills** * Familiarity with requirements, documentation, and verification * Familiarity with Computer Aided Design (CAD) tools used for schematic capture of printed circuit board designs * Familiarity with electrical hardware design and documentation from top assembly to subassemblies, including assembly drawings, schematics, wire lists, parts lists, printed circuit boards, interconnect diagrams, configuration drawings, etc. * Experience and working knowledge of electronic circuits (analog, digital and power) and experience working electronic instruments * Electronics simulation, troubleshooting, and instrument familiarity (analog, digital, power, communications). * Familiarity with integration, troubleshooting, and debug skills. * Demonstrated proficiency in problem solving and critical thinking. * Effective communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills * Ability to read, edit, and integrate software **Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering * Experience with Cadence System Capture PWB design tools * Experience with ADS, LTSpice, and HFSS simulation tools * Experience with the development of test equipment for flight controls, weapon controls, data links, and antennas. **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $69439 \- $118047 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. **About BAE Systems Electronic Systems** BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Electronic Systems (ES) is the global innovator behind BAE Systems’ game\-changing defense and commercial electronics. Exploiting every electron, we push the limits of what is possible, giving our customers the edge and our employees opportunities to change the world. Our products and capabilities can be found everywhere – from the depths of the ocean to the far reaches of space. At our core are more than 14,000 highly talented Electronic Systems employees with the brightest minds in the industry, we make an impact – for our customers and the communities we serve. This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.title: GIS Field Technician
jobs.description: Description: BETA Group, Inc is looking for a May 2027 graduate ready to turn their GIS skills into real\-world impact! As a **GIS Field Technician**, you’ll help municipalities see their communities in a whole new way—mapping the infrastructure people rely on every day, from sidewalks and curb ramps to streets and stormwater utilities. At BETA, we bring GIS, engineering, planning, and environmental science together to help towns and cities better understand the places they serve. You’ll be out in the field collecting data, developing and analyzing spatial information, and bringing it to life through web\-based platforms that help communities make smarter, data\-driven decisions. The work you do will directly support safer, more efficient, and more sustainable communities. This is an opportunity to get out from behind the classroom and put your GIS skills to work on projects that matter. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers, planners, and scientists, gain hands\-on experience in the field and in the office, and build your skills through mentorship, cross\-training, and real project experience. **Responsibilities:** * Assist with the collection of field data and perform asset inspections * Perform field measurements including but not limited to roadway, sidewalks, curb ramps, and other municipal infrastructure within the Right of Way * Take ownership of daily field operations, including planning, coordinating, and executing data collection to meet project goals * Edit and validate the collected data under the guidance of the project manager * Help build and maintain geographic databases, tables, forms, and reports that bring municipal data to life * Collaborate closely with engineers, planners, and other staff to ensure project deliverables meet high\-quality standards * Use cutting\-edge technology like tablets, GPS devices, and GIS software to capture, manage, and analyze data efficiently Preferred location is BETA’s Lincoln, RI office. Candidates should have flexibility to work from our other office locations. BETA also offers a hybrid work schedule, allowing employees to request working remotely up to 2 days per week. Requirements: **Required Experience/Skills****:** * Bachelor’s degree program in GIS, Geography, Geology, Planning, Civil Engineering, or a related field * 1 to 3 years of related GIS experience * GIS principles, concepts, and applications * Proficient in the use of current technology (i.e., tablets, smart phones, laptops, etc.) * Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite * Strong technical aptitude with an eagerness to learn * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * Strong problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail * Must be able to collect field data and measurements including but not limited to roadway, sidewalk, and utility assets; and perform asset inspections * Must be able to lift/move objects weighing up to 40 pounds * Must be able to perform field work in both hot and cold weather (rain and/or snow) * Must be able to stand or sit for long periods of time * Must have a valid driver’s license and reliable transportation **Preferred Experience/Skills****:** * ESRI Suite (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS online, etc.) to create and publish map services * Working knowledge of GPS equipment * AutoCAD **About BETA:** **BETA Group, Inc. is a New England based consultant engineering firm and leader in the fields of transportation, traffic, structural, civil/site, and water/wastewater engineering; landscape architecture; urban design and planning; GIS/asset management; environmental sciences and permitting; and construction services. BETA is 100% employee\-owned and offers an exceptional compensation and benefits package including:** * **Medical, Dental, Vision, and Additional Voluntary Life Insurance** * **Short\-Term \& Long\-Term Disability Coverage** * **Medical \& Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA)** * **Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)** * **Tuition Assistance** * **Professional Development** * **Employee Engagement Program** * **401(k) Plan with annual 401k match** **BETA is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants must be eligible for employment in the USA without sponsorship.**

jobs.title: 2027 BNY Analyst Program - Engineering (Developer) - Pittsburgh, PA
jobs.description: **2027 BNY Analyst Program – Engineering (Developer)** The 2027 BNY Analyst Program \- Engineering (Developer) provides high\-potential students with a well\-rounded, rewarding rotational experience with engaging Agile Projects while providing first\-hand knowledge of our culture, people, business, and impact within the marketplace. 2027 BNY Analyst Program \- Engineering (Developer) analysts will participate in a robust technical experience in JavaScript, Python, CSS, Java, and more. **What you will do** * Contribute across the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle by translating client and business needs into technical designs; building and enhancing features, APIs, automation, developer tools, and platform capabilities; and supporting testing, release, monitoring, and continuous improvement. * Use best\-in\-class, enterprise\-approved AI coding tools to accelerate development, testing, debugging, and documentation while validating outputs and protecting information. * Apply modern engineering practices, including source control, code review, reusable frameworks, automated testing, and CI/CD. Collaborate with engineers, architects, and product partners to solve problems and deliver secure, reliable solutions. * **Skills you will build** * Software engineering foundations: Create clean and maintainable code, data structures, APIs, version control, code review, technical documentation, and debugging. * AI\-enabled engineering: Providing effective context to AI tools, evaluating AI\-generated code, recognizing limitations, maintaining human oversight, and using AI responsibly. * Automated quality and secure delivery: Unit and integration testing, test automation, continuous integration and delivery, secure coding, and vulnerability management. * Platform and reliability fundamentals: Reusable frameworks, cloud and container concepts, observability, performance, resilience, and standardized engineering workflows. * Product and business acumen: Connecting technical work to client needs, financial services outcomes, risk, controls, and measurable value. Professional collaboration: Working in a cross\-functional team, communicating technical decisions, giving and receiving feedback, and learning from experienced engineers. * **Impact you will have at BNY** * Contribute to the development of applications and features that support business and engineering needs. * Help improve software quality by identifying issues, testing solutions, and supporting implementation. * Support teams in delivering reliable, effective technology solutions through strong development practices. See how software development powers innovation at a global financial services leader. * **Why this could be a fit for you** * This role is a strong fit if you enjoy coding, problem\-solving, and building technology solutions. * You are interested in learning how applications are developed, tested, and implemented in a professional environment. * You like working through technical challenges and improving how software performs. You are curious, collaborative, and excited to keep growing your software development skills. * **Analyst Program** Our 24\-month rotational Analyst Program is designed to set you up for success from day one. New joiners take part in a structured induction experience to help them assimilate into BNY, learn about the organization, connect with peers and leaders, and build the core skills needed to navigate their early career with confidence. From day one, analysts are immersed in BNY's collaborative and innovative culture through: * Enterprise\-wide onboarding and development programming, including an in person immersive induction experience, executive speaker series, skill development, and networking opportunities. * Meaningful project work aligned to key business practices and platforms, providing hands\-on experience, skill development, and real\-world business impact. * Structured mentorship and career support from managers, senior leaders, peer mentors, business stakeholders, and dedicated program managers. * Exposure across practices, platforms, and teams, building a broad understanding of BNY's integrated business model. * Professional, technical, and financial services training designed to strengthen business acumen and prepare participants for long\-term career success. A premier early\-career experience, backed by senior leadership and designed to develop the next generation of talent for BNY's global workforce. * **Program eligibility:** * Enrollment in a 4\-year undergraduate degree program with a strong focus on business\-related and/or technology\-related majors preferred. * Graduating in Dec 2026 or May 2027 (U.S.). * Minimum cumulative GPA of 3\.0 or better. * Does not require sponsorship for employment visa status (now or in the future) in the country where applying.

jobs.title: Autonomous Learning Engineer

jobs.title: Prin Business Program Manager - BGE Project Initiation Team
jobs.description: Who We Are: We're powering a cleaner, brighter future. Exelon is leading the energy transformation, and we're calling all problem solvers, innovators, community builders and change makers. Work with us to deliver solutions that make our diverse cities and communities stronger, healthier and more resilient. We're powered by purpose\-driven people like you who believe in being inclusive and creative, and value safety, innovation, integrity and community service. We are a Fortune 200 company, 20,000 colleagues strong serving more than 10\.7 million customers at six energy companies \- Atlantic City Electric (ACE), Baltimore Gas and Electric (BGE), Commonwealth Edison (ComEd), Delmarva Power \& Light (DPL), PECO Energy Company (PECO), and Potomac Electric Power Company (Pepco). We're committed to creating an environment where every person can thrive. Our employee experience is grounded in four tenets that guide how we support our people: purposeful careers, growth opportunities, community impact, and support to thrive. In our relentless pursuit of excellence, we elevate diverse voices, fresh perspectives and bold thinking. And since we know transforming the future of energy is hard work, we provide competitive compensation, incentives, excellent benefits and the opportunity to build a rewarding career. Are you in? Primary Purpose: **The Principal Business Program Manager is a critical member of BGE’s Project Initiation Team, responsible for establishing centralized ownership, visibility, and escalating early\-stage and portfolio\-wide project risk for major Transmission and Substation capital projects.** Partnering closely with Project Initiation leadership, Project Controls, Engineering, Planning, Finance, and Investment Strategy, this role leads risk identification during project initiation, develops and maintains standardized risk registers, and provides portfolio\-level risk insights to inform governance decisions, capital forecasting, mitigation planning, and leadership escalation. By integrating risk, scope, schedule, and cost perspectives, this role strengthens project readiness, improves financial predictability, and ensures critical risks are identified, quantified where possible, assigned to accountable owners, and escalated before they impact execution, regulatory outcomes, or portfolio performance. The ideal candidate will possess demonstrated Transmission and Substation project experience, strong front\-end project development expertise, and the ability to lead cross\-functional risk management practices across complex utility capital portfolios. In addition, this role is responsible for portfolio\-level risk monitoring across all centrally managed Transmission projects supported by PIT. The Principal Business Program Manager maintains a consolidated view of risk exposure, identifies systemic issues and emerging threats, tracks time\-sensitive risks and decision points, and monitors mitigation commitments to ensure risks do not go unmanaged as projects progress from initiation. through execution. Acting as an early\-warning and portfolio governance function, not a project firefighter, the role ensures the right risks are elevated to the right stakeholders at the right time, enabling proactive leadership decisions, stronger Investment Strategy coordination, and improved portfolio accountability. The Principal Business Program Manager does not perform project execution activities. Instead, **the role enables successful execution by ensuring that risks are clearly understood, assessed for probability and impact, quantified where practical, assigned to owners, linked to mitigation strategies, and aligned with governance expectations prior to project handoff. This position plays a key role in transforming fragmented, siloed initiation practices into a disciplined, transparent, and enterprise\-aligned project initiation and risk management framework.** Position may be required to work extended hours for coverage during storms or other energy delivery emergencies. Primary Duties: * Develop, manage, and continuously improve PIT’s portfolio\-wide project risk management framework, including risk identification practices, standardized risk register requirements, probability and impact assessment criteria, escalation thresholds, reporting cadence, and governance expectations. (25%) * Lead structured risk identification with cross\-functional stakeholders across Planning, Engineering, Project Controls, Finance, Investment Strategy, Project Management, Legal, Real Estate, Regulatory, and other supporting organizations. Apply risk identification techniques including workshops, interviews, assumptions analysis, lessons learned reviews, dependency mapping, readiness reviews, and review of scope, schedule, cost, permitting, regulatory, outage, constructability, and stakeholder inputs. (20%) * Coordinate risk mitigation strategies with Investment Strategy, Finance, Engineering, Planning, Project Controls, and projec ment) to support business needs. * Demonstrated business acumen and ability to create value with advanced problem solving, financial/analytical, performance management, negotiation, and conflict management skills. * Demonstrated ability to lead a cross\-functional team. Demonstrated ability to build consensus, establish trust, meet critical deadlines, communicate effectively, and foster culture change. * Customer driven with demonstrated excellent written and oral communication skills and ability to interact with people of all levels. * Demonstrated ability to develop and implement process enhancements and efficiencies including new technology * In lieu of degree, 9\-12 years of relevant experience. Preferred Qualifications: * **PMP, PMI\-RMP, CAPM, Six Sigma, or equivalent project, program, process improvement, or risk management certification.** * **Master’s degree in business administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Public Policy, Risk Management, Program Management, or related discipline, with coursework or focus areas on risk management, capital planning, portfolio management, project controls, or enterprise decision\-making.** * Demonstrated experience in portfolio\-level risk management, including development and maintenance of standardized risk matrices or registers, aggregation of project\-level risks into a consolidated portfolio view, and identification of systemic or cross\-cutting risks impacting capital delivery. * Experience supporting front\-end project initiation or feasibility activities, with strong understanding of how early\-stage scope, schedule, cost, outage, permitting, regulatory, constructability, and stakeholder decisions influence downstream execution and financial outcomes. * Proven ability to partner with Investment Strategy, Finance, Capital Planning, or Portfolio Management organizations to translate risk exposure into financial risk and opportunity implications, cash flow considerations, contingency assumptions, prioritization input, and capital portfolio guidance. * **Experience developing risk reporting, dashboards, metrics, or analytics using tools such as Power BI, Excel\-based models, or similar platforms to communicate portfolio risk trends, escalation points, mitigation status, and decision triggers.** * **Demonstrated ability to operate as an independent portfolio risk steward by monitoring risk status, tracking mitigation commitments, coordinating with accountable owners, and proactively escalating time\-sensitive risks without owning execution\-level resolution.** * **Experience working within a regulated utility environment, particularly Transmission or large capital project portfolios, with understanding of regulatory, permitting, external stakeholder, reliability, outage, and capital recovery risks.** * Strong stakeholder engagement and facilitation skills, including the ability to influence cross\-functional teams across Planning, Engineering, Project Controls, Project Management, Investment Strategy, Finance, Legal, Real Estate, and external partners. Benefits: * Annual salary will vary based on a candidate’s skills, qualifications, experience, and other factors: $114,400\.00/Yr. – $157,300\.00/Yr. * Annual Bonus for eligible positions: 20% * 401(k) match and annual company contribution * Medical, dental and vision insurance * Life and disability insurance * Generous paid time off options, including vacation, sick time, floating and fixed holidays, maternity leave and bonding/primary caregiver leave or parental leave * Employee Assistance Program and resources for mental and emotional support * Wellbeing programs such as tuition reimbursement, adoption and surrogacy assistance and fitness reimbursement * Referral bonus program * And much more Note: Exelon\-sponsored compensation and benefit programs may vary or not apply based on length of service, job grade, job classification or represented status. Eligibility will be determined by the written plan or program documents.

jobs.description: **Job Description:** At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being an inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognizing and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture with specific requirements for office\-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role\-specific considerations. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! **Position Summary:** This job is responsible for driving efforts to develop and deliver complex data solutions to accomplish technology and business goals. Key responsibilities include leading code design and delivery tasks with the integration, cleaning, transformation and control of data in operational and analytical data systems. Job expectations include liaising with vendors and working with stakeholders and Product and Software Engineering teams to implement data requirements, analyzing performance, and researching and troubleshooting issues within system engineering domains. * Infrastructure Information Services is seeking a Senior Data Streaming Engineer to design and deliver a modern, real\-time data platform supporting Infrastructure and ITSM domains. This role focuses on building scalable, low\-latency data pipelines using event\-driven architecture and stream processing technologies, while evolving legacy batch\-oriented systems into a streaming\-first ecosystem. * The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in data engineering, stream processing, and data lakehouse architectures, with hands\-on experience using Apache Flink, Confluent Kafka, and Apache Iceberg. This individual will help modernize data integration patterns, improve data freshness, and enable real\-time analytics aligned with enterprise data management standards. **Responsibilities:** * Leads story refinement and delivery of requirements through the delivery lifecycle and assists team members in resolving technical complexities * Codes complex solutions to integrate, clean, transform, and control data, builds processes supporting data transformation, data structures, metadata, data quality controls, dependency, and workload management, assembles complex data sets, and communicates required information for deployment * Leads documentation of system requirements, collaborates with development teams to understand data requirements and feasibility, and leverages architectural components to develop client requirements * Leads testing teams to develop test plans, contributes to existing test suites including integration, regression, and performance, analyzes test reports, identifies test issues and errors, and leads triage of underlying causes * Leads work efforts with technology partners and stakeholders to close gaps in data management standards adherence, negotiates paths forward by thinking outside the box to identify and communicate solutions to complex problems, and leverages knowledge of information systems, techniques, and processes * Leads complex information technology projects to ensure on\-time delivery and adherence to release processes and risk management and defines and builds data pipelines to enable data\-informed decision making * Mentors Data Engineers to enable continuous development and monitors key performance indicators and internal controls * Design and implement real\-time data pipelines using Apache Flink and Confluent Kafka * Transform legacy batch and RDBMS\-based data workflows into event\-driven streaming architectures * Build and optimize streaming ingestion, transformation, and enrichment pipelines * Develop and maintain Iceberg\-based data lakehouse tables to support both streaming and analytical workloads * Ensure data quality, reconciliation, and consistency across streaming and batch systems * Optimize performance of streaming jobs, including state management, checkpointing, and scalability * Design efficient partitioning, schema evolution, and storage strategies using Iceberg * Integrate data across multiple systems including ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow) * Collaborate with architecture and platform teams to establish best practices for streaming data frameworks * Support CI/CD, deployment, and operational monitoring of streaming pipelines **Required Qualifications:** * 10\+ years of IT experience with strong focus on data engineering * 5\+ years in data warehousing, data lakes, or MDM systems * Strong experience with: * Apache Flink (stream processing, event time, windowing, stateful processing) * Confluent Kafka (topics, partitions, schema registry, connectors) * Apache Iceberg (table format, partition evolution, ACID, time travel) * Proficiency with: * Python, PySpark, or Java/Scala for data engineering * SQL (advanced querying and optimization) * Experience designing event\-driven and streaming architectures * Deep understanding of data modeling for streaming and lakehouse systems * Experience working with Kafka\-based ingestion patterns and CDC frameworks * Knowledge of data formats (Parquet, Avro) and optimization techniques * Experience integrating with RDBMS (Oracle, DB2, SQL Server) and migrating to modern platforms * Familiarity with Hadoop ecosystem components (Spark, Hive, HDFS) in hybrid environments * Experience with SDLC practices, CI/CD pipelines, and version control * Strong ability to translate design into production\-grade implementations **Desired Qualifications:** * Experience with real\-time analytics use cases (monitoring, alerting, observability) * Hands\-on experience with Kafka Connect, ksqlDB, or stream enrichment frameworks * Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and metadata management * Experience with cloud\-based data platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) * Exposure to DevOps and infrastructure automation * Experience with Agile tools such as Jira and Bitbucket **Skills:** * Analytical Thinking * Application Development * Data Management * DevOps Practices * Solution Design * Agile Practices * Collaboration * Decision Making * Risk Management * Test Engineering * Architecture * Data Quality Management * Other **Shift:** 1st shift (United States of America) **Hours Per Week:** 40

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer I
jobs.description: **Department Name:** IT Identity Access Mgmt\-Corp**Work Shift:** Day**Job Category:** Information Technology Health care is constantly changing, and at Banner Health, we are at the front of that change. We are leading health care to make the experience the best it can be. We want to change the lives of those in our care – and the people who choose to take on this challenge. If changing health care for the better sounds like something you want to be part of, we want to hear from you. As a Cybersecurity Engineer I, you will be part of an Enterprise\-wide Cybersecurity Engineering team responsible for Identity and Access Management (IAM), tasked with the planning, implementation, and support of the Enterprise IAM Platform. Expertise should include Feature Development and Deployment, Access Certifications, Provisioning, Modeling, Workflows \& Automation. This impactful position will be responsible for the design, deployment, configuration, and maintenance of an IAM platform in a multi\-state enterprise environment. Candidates should have experience with various programming and development platforms including Git, Java, JavaScript, PowerShell, SQL, and Agile project management methodologies. They should also have a solid understanding of Identity Access Management and Identity Governance tools, preferably with SailPoint’s IdentityIQ, IdentityNow, or similar. Candidates should also understand IAM best practices that will drive maturity and adoption of the platform across the enterprise. **This is a remote position. In this role you would work Monday through Friday normal business with on\-call support. This is a remote position only if you live in the following states only: AL, AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, ND, NE, NH, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV \& WY. NO other states will be considered.** Your pay and benefits (Total Rewards) are important components of your Journey at Banner Health. Banner Health offers a variety of benefit plans to help you and your family. We provide health and financial security options, so you can focus on being the best at what you do and enjoying your life. Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally\-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award\-winning patient care. POSITION SUMMARY This position designs, develops, configures, implements, tunes, maintains solutions, resolve technical and business issues related to cybersecurity threat \& vulnerability management, identity management, security operations center, forensics, and data protection. Cybersecurity Engineers work with Cybersecurity Architects to execute strategic cyber initiatives, evaluate security components of the network, applications and end\-user devices, and provides guidance to ensure new systems meet regulatory and technical standards. Cybersecurity Engineers participate in root\-cause analysis efforts to determine improvement opportunities when failures occur. Manage Cyber systems, ensures they are tuned, on the current release and manages appropriate change management across the IT organization and the business. CORE FUNCTIONS 1\. Participates in the design and implementation of cybersecurity solutions. 2\. Participates in providing technical expertise and support for cybersecurity solutions, including operational aspects of the software. 3\. Participates in the design, implementation, and compliance of secure baseline configurations for applications and infrastructure components. 4\. Performs technical assessments of systems and applications to ensure compliance with policy, standards and regulations. 5\. Participates in the ongoing evaluation and development of security policies and procedures. Leads the revision of policies and procedures, as needed. 6\. Update, sustain, and administer a high level of security for in\-house security infrastructures and services. 7\. Participates in cybersecurity projects, including the development of project scope requirements, budgeting, work breakdown. 8\. Under general direction, this position is responsible for cybersecurity across multiple departments system\-wide and requires interaction at all levels of staff and management. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Must possess strong knowledge of business, information security and/or computer science as normally obtained through the completion of a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems, or a related field. 0\-3 years of experience of enterprise\-scale information security engineering, preferably in healthcare. Experience with IT operations and or Security operations is also highly desirable. Experience with automation of security processes, coding and scripting languages. Ability to perform acquisition process, including vendor selection, define requirements, contractual documentation development. Ability to document security processes as well as Use case development. Proficient understanding of regulatory and compliance mandates, including but not limited to HIPAA, HITECH, PCI, Sarbanes\-Oxley. Experienced assessing and reaching out to vendors for needed features via enhancement requests. Experienced in planning, designing and implementing cybersecurity solutions. Experienced in operating, maintaining and the lifecycle of cybersecurity solutions. Knowledge of Security Engineering Principles, including risk management, resilience, vulnerability management, Information Security, and security operations. Requires independent judgment, critical decision making, excellent analytical skills, with excellent verbal and written communications. Ability to think quickly under difficult or complex conditions and clearly communicate to appropriate staff; ability to balance project workloads with customer support and on\-call demands. Must demonstrate general knowledge of information technology and information security principles and practices. Requires communication and presentation skills to engage technical and non\-technical audiences. Requires ability to communicate and interact across facilities and at various levels. As is typical in this industry, variable shifts and hours and responding to after\-hours notifications may be required. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Certification in one(1\)of the following areas Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP), HealthCare Information Security \& Privacy Practitioner, (HCISPP), CompTIA Security\+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) – Engineering (ISSEP), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), SANS GIAC, or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA). Two years as a System Administrator, Security operations or in IT Operations. Or two years risk management or GRC experience in the healthcare/medical environment. Additional related education and/or experience preferred. **Estimated Pay Range:** $37\.14 \- $61\.90 / hour Banner Health is committed to pay equity and transparency. The posted compensation range is a reasonable estimate that extends from the lowest to the highest pay Banner Health in good faith believes it might pay for this particular job, based on the circumstances at the time of posting. This range is based on possible base salaries and does not include the value of our total rewards package. Actual pay determined at offer will be based on years of relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location, along with a review of current employees in similar roles to ensure pay equity is achieved and maintained. **EEO Statement:** EEO/Disabled/Veterans Our organization supports a drug\-free work environment. **Privacy Policy:** Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer (Backend)-Fuel Distribution SaaS
jobs.description: About the role We are building FuelOps: an integrated operations and finance platform for petroleum and bulk fuel distribution, and then for the wider transportation industry. This is not a greenfield idea looking for its first user. A working version is already running the business today. We built a full ERP covering dispatch, yard operations, driver logistics, inventory, and a complete general ledger that replaced QuickBooks Desktop. It has 56 data tables, tens of thousands of posted GL transactions, and it is in live beta right now with real loads and real money moving through it. We are now rebuilding it as a standalone multi\-tenant SaaS product on Postgres and AWS, because the low\-code platform we proved it on cannot be sold to anyone else. You would be the first engineer. You would work directly with the two founders, one of whom built the current system and knows every table in it. What you would actually build Year one, concretely: * Design the second\-generation data model from a ruled architecture specification. It is not a port of the existing schema. The entity core models quantity, identity, conversion, and transformability as independent typed traits, carries dual quantity with conversion provenance on every ledger row, and treats ownership and custody as separate axes. * Build the immutable transaction ledger and the general ledger posting engine. Balances are derived from the ledger, never written directly. Nothing edits history. You will do this alongside a founder who has already built one; you do not have to arrive knowing it. * Re\-express business rules that currently live in the low\-code layer as database constraints, triggers, and server\-side code: negative\-stock guards, delivery\-date authority, GL posting sequencing, blend and inventory movement rules. * Write the one\-time migration that loads a frozen export of the current system into the new model. * Stand up the platform foundations that do not exist yet: repository, CI, migration discipline, environments, backups, observability. * Multi\-tenancy, tenant isolation, and customer\-administered roles and permissions. * Document storage and lifecycle on object storage, not in the database. Beyond year one: third\-party integrations (fleet telematics, banking, fuel card networks, e\-invoicing, rack pricing feeds), a motor fuel tax engine, compliance tracking modules, mobile applications for drivers and yard staff, a public API, and a background AI layer that audits data entry and forecasts replenishment. What you need to be able to do Non\-negotiable: * Advanced relational data modeling in Postgres. Not ORM\-driven schema. You design normalized models, enforce invariants in the database rather than only in application code, write real SQL, and can reason about transaction isolation and concurrency. This is the core of the job and the thing we will dig into hardest. * Own a backend service end to end in production. Schema, API, deployment, monitoring, incident response. There is no platform team to hand it to. There is no team at all yet. * Migration discipline. Versioned, reviewed, reversible migrations applied by automation, never by hand against production. * AWS fundamentals: RDS, S3, IAM, networking, and infrastructure defined as code. * Work from a written specification and push back on it. Much of the architecture is already ruled and documented. We want someone who reads it, finds the flaw, and argues the case, not someone who implements it silently or ignores it. * Care about correctness over velocity. This system posts to a general ledger that a real business closes its books on. A fast feature that quietly corrupts a balance is worse than no feature. Strongly preferred. Any of these moves you toward the top of the range: * Double\-entry financial systems. Debits and credits, immutable ledgers, derived balances, period close, reconciliation. If you have shipped something where a balance being wrong was a real problem, lead with it in your application. * ERP, accounting, logistics, WMS, TMS, or similar transactional back\-office systems. * Multi\-tenant SaaS: tenant isolation, per\-tenant configuration, noisy\-neighbor and data\-leak risk. * Third\-party API integration where the other side is a bank, a regulator, or an enterprise vendor with poor documentation and no sandbox. * Enough front\-end capability to build usable internal and customer screens. You do not need to be a designer, but you will be building UI in year one. Useful, not required. We will teach the rest: * Petroleum, bulk liquids, hazmat, or trucking operations. * Motor fuel excise tax, DOT and FMCSA compliance, IFTA. * SOC 2 or comparable compliance preparation. * Mobile development, offline\-first sync, ML or forecasting work. * Experience migrating off a low\-code platform. Location and schedule Based in Katy, Texas, hybrid. We expect meaningful in\-person time, particularly in the first several months. This is deliberate. The product models physical operations: tanks, loads, meters, drivers, terminals. An engineer who has never watched a dispatcher build a load or seen a truck weigh out will model the wrong thing. We will get you in front of the actual operation. Travel to company terminals in Navasota and San Angelo is occasional, not routine. How we work * Specifications are written down and decisions are recorded with their reasoning. We do not rely on what somebody remembers. * One thing at a time, verified before the next thing starts. The existing system was built to zero compile errors as a standing bar and we intend to keep that habit. * Anything touching live production is gated and deliberate. The business runs on this. * We use AI tooling heavily and expect you to. It does not lower the bar for understanding what you shipped. Compensation and what this is $130,000 – $150,000 base. The top of the range is for candidates bringing real experience with financial, accounting, or ledger\-backed systems. Full\-time W\-2 with \[BENEFITS]. We are funded by an operating business, not by investors. That means no runway clock, no board deck, no pressure to inflate numbers, and no risk of the money disappearing in eighteen months. It also means we are not paying Bay Area compensation and there is no venture\-scale equity lottery ticket. What you get instead is unusual leverage. A product with a real, paying, working first customer from day one. A domain where the incumbent tools are genuinely bad and the buyers know it. No legacy codebase to inherit, only a legacy system to learn from. And the architecture decisions that will shape this product for the next decade are being made now, by a team of three, with you in the room. If you want to be employee number thirty on a mature platform team, this is the wrong role. If you want to design the data model that a company runs on for the next decade, it is the right one. To apply Send a resume and a short note covering: * A data model you are proud of, and one you got wrong and had to live with. * A time you found a flaw in a specification or design you were handed, and what you did about it. * Whether you would rather be handed a specification or write one, and why. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Katy, TX 77450

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Full-Stack) — Fuel Distribution SaaS
jobs.description: About the role We are building FuelOps: an integrated operations and finance platform for petroleum and bulk fuel distribution. This is not a startup idea looking for its first customer. A working version already runs the business today. We built a full ERP covering dispatch, yard operations, driver logistics, inventory, and a complete general ledger that replaced QuickBooks Desktop. It is in live beta right now with real loads and real money moving through it. We are rebuilding it as a standalone multi\-tenant SaaS product on Postgres and AWS. You would be the second engineer, working directly alongside our founding engineer and the two founders. This is a real apprenticeship, not a title. You will be mentored by a senior engineer, you will get code review on everything, and you will be given work that is genuinely hard slightly before you feel ready for it. In exchange we expect you to be the kind of person who chases down the answer rather than waiting to be told. What you would actually do The job has two halves, and both matter. Half one: keep the current system running. Our existing ERP is live and people depend on it every day. While the senior engineer builds the replacement, you would own day\-to\-day support of the current system: investigating issues users report, tracing what actually happened through the data, fixing what is fixable, and documenting what is not. This is how you learn the business, and it is the reason the rebuild can go fast. Half two: build pieces of the new platform. * Front\-end screens against designs and specifications the senior engineer writes. * Migration verification: reconciliation scripts that prove the data moved from the old system to the new one without loss or distortion. Tedious, high\-stakes, and the best way anyone has ever learned a data model. * Automated tests, including the ones that catch a ledger going out of balance. * Integration client code against documented third\-party APIs. * Internal and administrative tooling. * Documentation that a future engineer can actually use. Over time, and depending on what you are good at, this grows toward owning features end to end. What you need * 1 to 3 years of professional software experience, or a strong project portfolio. Bootcamp graduates and self\-taught engineers are welcome. We care about what you can do and how you think, not where you learned it. * Working SQL. You can write a join, a group\-by, and a subquery without looking them up, and you understand what a foreign key is for. We will teach you the rest, and there is a lot of rest. * At least one language you are comfortable in. Python, TypeScript, C\#, Java, Go, whatever. We care that you know one well more than that you know five slightly. * You can read code you did not write and figure out what it does before asking. * Careful with other people’s data. This system holds a real company’s inventory and general ledger. Guessing is not a strategy here. We would much rather you stop and ask than push something you are unsure of. * Clear written communication. Much of the work is remote\-async against written specifications, and half your job involves explaining to a non\-technical person what went wrong. Nice to have, none of it required * Any exposure to Postgres specifically. * Microsoft Power Platform, Power Apps, Power Fx, or Dataverse. Our current system is built on it, so this is unusually useful here even though it is not a long\-term skill for us. * Accounting coursework, bookkeeping experience, or any familiarity with debits and credits. * Trucking, logistics, fuel, warehouse, or field operations experience of any kind, including non\-technical. If you have worked a yard or dispatched trucks and then learned to code, we want to talk to you. * Git, CI, cloud infrastructure, or AWS exposure. * Experience supporting software that other people depend on daily. Location and schedule Based in Katy, Texas, hybrid. In\-person time matters more for this role than most, because you are learning a business as much as a codebase, and because pairing with the senior engineer is how you get good quickly. Occasional visits to company terminals in Navasota and San Angelo. You will spend time around the actual operation: tanks, trucks, meters, dispatchers. That is a feature of the job, not a chore. How we work * Specifications are written down and decisions are recorded with their reasoning. Nobody has to guess what was decided or why. * One thing at a time, verified before the next thing starts. * Anything touching live production is gated and deliberate. The business runs on this. * We use AI tooling heavily and expect you to. It does not lower the bar for understanding what you shipped, and "the AI wrote it" is not an explanation of how something works. * Questions are cheap. Silent guessing on a live ledger is expensive. Compensation and what this is $85,000 – $100,000 base, depending on experience. Full\-time W\-2 with \[BENEFITS]. We are funded by an operating business, not by investors. No runway clock, no layoff risk from a funding round that does not close. For someone early in their career, the specific offer here is scope you would wait years for elsewhere. On a team this small there is no queue for interesting work, no layer of process between you and the person who decides, and no possibility of spending two years on a single component of somebody else’s system. You will see how a real company’s operations and finances actually work, from the inside, which almost no engineer ever does. It is also demanding. Small team, real consequences, and nobody to hide behind. To apply Send a resume and a short note covering: * Something you built, what it does, and one thing about it you would do differently now. * A bug or problem you had to chase down, and how you actually found the cause. * Why this role rather than a larger, more conventional engineering team. No cover letter formalities needed. A few honest paragraphs beat a polished template. Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Katy, TX 77450

In this exciting and challenging role as a test engineer specializing in hardware and firmware, you will contribute to the development of new and modified EEG and Home Sleep Test systems that meet application, business, customer, and regulatory requirements. You will be working in the Device Team, reporting to the VP of Device Systems and working closely with hardware, firmware, system, and software engineers. You are responsible for hardware characterization and verification tests, firmware unit tests, integration tests, verification tests, system integration, root cause analysis, and documentation to meet quality requirements. Your goal as a hardware test engineer is to strive without reserve for the greatest quality and reliability in our products. To accomplish this goal, you will collaborate with other design, research, manufacturing and quality colleagues to develop products from concept to commercialization. You will contribute to product idealization, development, integration verification, and manufacturing. Additionally, you will document design and production processes in accordance with applicable product development procedures, quality and regulatory requirements. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first\-class remote work experience, but we also have in\-person office hubs available located in Boston, New York, and Paris. This role is required to work from the Boston office on average approximately 3 days per week with flexible days and hours. **What success looks like:** * Develop and execute device testing in accordance with Beacon's QMS. * Develop and document test plans, test protocols, and test scripts for embedded systems, including hardware, firmware, and software, based on design specifications and requirements. * Develop and maintain test procedures, fixtures, and equipment. * Conduct functional, integration, system, and regression testing on hardware and firmware. * Work closely with hardware and firmware engineers to troubleshoot and resolve product issues. * Ensure products meet industry standards, safety, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, CE, 60601\). * Implement process improvements and test automation to enhance product quality and testing efficiency. **What you will bring:** * Education: BS in engineering or related field. * Work Experience (post\-graduate): 5\+ years of professional engineering experience with a BS degree or 3\+ years of professional engineering experience with an MS degree or above. * You have experience with writing detailed technical specifications and documentation, including requirements, test plans, protocols, and reports. * You can read and follow electrical schematics. * You have experience with embedded software that runs on a real\-time operating system (RTOS). * You have experience with scripting languages such as Python. * You have experience with troubleshooting, debugging, and root cause analysis of hardware and firmware issues in electromechanical systems. * You have experience with tools like Git/JIRA and platforms like GitHub. * Preferably, you have knowledge of design controls and regulations for medical devices. The salary range for this role is $120,000 – $140,000\. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description: Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at\-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at\-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology. Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join our Datastore team. The Datastore sits at the heart of Beacon's platform. It defines our foundational data model and serves as the centralized repository and API for brain data collected from clinical studies, supporting the analytical tools, services, and applications used by our scientists, clinicians, and partners. This role emphasizes the design and scaling of backend systems for data infrastructure: PostgreSQL data models, Kafka\-driven event pipelines, and the GraphQL API that makes scientific and clinical data usable \- distinct from frontend development or end\-user product surfaces. At this level you will lead the design of complex systems within the Datastore rather than individual components, own the pipelines that deliver dataset snapshots into our warehouse, and collaborate across platform, application and scientific teams to implement APIs that unlock new workflows in Beacon's expanding portfolio of clinical studies and digital health products. You should expect to write SQL by hand, and to reason about schema design, indexes, and query behavior as a matter of course. This role is 100% remote from anywhere in the U.S. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first\-class remote work experience, but we also have in\-person office hubs in Boston, New York City, and Paris. ### **What success looks like** * You lead design and architecture for complex projects and systems within the Datastore, weighing implementation trade\-offs with engineering principles and backing your decisions with data rather than preference * You partner with product managers, scientific and clinical stakeholders, and other development and support teams to translate their requirements into new integrations, services, and solutions for scaling Beacon's data platform \- contributing to broader product and technical decisions, not simply implementing them * You debug and profile ambiguous problems that cross system boundaries, including codebases beyond the Datastore's purview, and you leave what you touch better than you found it — structure, test coverage, tooling * Peers look to your work as an example: you implement features with attention to detail, demonstrating product awareness and high standards for data integrity, design soundness, and maintainability across the lifespan of the system * You draft RFCs to lead complex feature discovery and technical design phases, soliciting and incorporating input, and helping your team align on a set of decisions to guide development * You plan your own work and contribute to planning the team's, making reasoned trade\-offs between speed, generalizability, and technical debt, and accounting for the needs of multiple stakeholder teams * You teach and mentor other engineers regularly, give feedback that people act on, and are sought out for it. You may act as tech lead on a project or as the coordination point for engineering practice within the team * You leverage feedback from internal stakeholders and external partners to improve operational robustness and ease of use of the Datastore and its services via new documentation, tools, and dashboards ### **What you will bring** * 7\+ years of backend development experience, including at least 3 years focused on data platforms and backend infrastructure for data\-centric applications: transactional systems, event pipelines, and the APIs that serve them * Highly proficient in at least one technical area relevant to this work: data modeling, distributed systems, API design, or database engineering, with the depth that others on a team come to you for * Strong proficiency in SQL, with production experience working with PostgreSQL as an application database; you write and tune queries fluently and are comfortable reasoning about schema design, indexes, and query plans * Hands\-on experience with data streaming and event processing, using Kafka (our event bus) or an equivalent such as RabbitMQ, Pulsar, or a cloud\-based equivalent like Amazon Kinesis * Proficiency in Julia or Python; Julia is a core Datastore language, and experience with Julia is a strong plus, but not required — we welcome candidates eager to learn it! * Experience with GraphQL and TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js) \- GraphQL is the Datastore's primary interface * Experience deploying and operating services in containerized environments, with familiarity in Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and/or Helm * A track record of mentoring engineers and improving how a team works \- practices, tooling, test coverage, or documentation that outlasted your involvement * A collaborative mindset: you enjoy working across disciplines and believe people achieve more together than alone * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous and remote\-friendly environments * A self\-directed approach, with a track record of thriving in hybrid or fully remote teams * Experience with, or interest in, using LLM\-assisted or agentic coding tools in a production setting, with good judgment about what guardrails are needed We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If you bring strong fundamentals, care about data infrastructure for health, and are excited to learn, we'd love to hear from you! The US\-based salary range for this role is $170,000 – $190,000\. jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Quality Engineer** **Your Impact. Our Legacy.** At Bemis Manufacturing Company, you’re not just joining a team—you’re becoming part of a family that’s been crafting innovation, quality, and tradition for over 120 years. Rooted in Sheboygan Falls, WI, we’re driven by a commitment to creating products that make a difference in everyday life while fostering an environment where our employees can thrive, grow, and achieve their personal and professional goals. When you join Bemis, you’re stepping into a workplace where your ideas are valued, your contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless. We believe in empowering individuals to make meaningful impacts—on our products, our customers, and our community. Together, we’ll shape the future while honoring our legacy. Are you ready to make your mark and build a career that truly matters? Join us at Bemis Manufacturing Company, where your passion meets purpose. The Quality Engineer will be responsible for providing leadership in the areas of product quality for commercial requirements of compression molded and assembled proprietary products. The incumbent will support Compression Molding Seat Operations, manage, and improve the quality system. The incumbent will live the corporate values of treating people with dignity and respect, practicing leadership, driving continuous improvement, acting with a sense of urgency, promoting innovation, fighting for consensus, and managing through teams. **Specific Responsibilities:** * Translate the commercial requirements into methods and procedures for process control, process improvement, testing and inspection to ensure that the products are free of flaws and function as designed. * Create/maintain performance reports for quality and scrap\-related metrics; help identify problem products/processes, work with problem\-solving teams. * Have a good understanding of product standards, requirements, and test methods for materials and finished products; develop supporting procedures and records. * Work with production managers in all decisions relating to product quality / acceptability. * Develop good relationships with key suppliers of wood, resin, paint, and vinyl components. * Act as liaison between manufacturing and internal/external suppliers and customers. * Prepare customer\-specific quality documentation—PPAP’s, Corrective/Preventive Action, Product Certifications, etc. * Respond to customer complaints and rejects. Coordinate containment, communication, corrective action as needed. Lead corrective and preventative actions for Thermoset Proprietary Seats. * Communicate customer returns / quality concerns to manufacturing floor employees and Production Management. * Evaluate new/existing materials and sources. * Coordinate testing for new and revised tooling, and production materials. * Maintain procedures and records up to date and preserve historical data for quality and production measurables. * Support/assist gauge calibration function and activities of the Color Team. * Participate in continuous improvement efforts, specifically those related to compression molding. Use and promote the use of statistics and other analytical tools for evaluating and improving product quality. * Oversee the activity of the Particle Reduction Lab Technician in quality\-related lab work. * Manage and improve the systems and procedures to ensure proper tolerances for new and existing color. * Act as Thermoset representative for customer audits and FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) certification **Skills \& Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline; or equivalent mix of education and experience. * 3\-5 years of experience in Quality in a manufacturing environment. * Experience dealing with compression molding processes beneficial. * Strong problem\-solving disciplines and analytical skills. * Proactive and takes action without being prompted. * Communication –ability to present information and work effectively with cross\-functional work groups including suppliers, customers, and associates, both verbally and in writing. * Experience with other quality software applications beneficial (e.g., statistical analysis). * Strong computer literacy. * Strong organizational/project management skills a plus.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description: **About Beside’s mission** ========================== Beside is building an AI agent that helps small businesses grow, giving owners more time for their craft, their customers, and their lives. We’re building for the people who run the real economy: the plumber between jobs, the family salon, the local gym owner. They started a business to do something they’re good at. But running it means wearing every hat: finding customers, answering calls, following up on quotes, booking appointments, and chasing payments. Every missed call or forgotten follow\-up can mean lost revenue. Beside takes that work off their plate. We’re building a 24/7 agent that understands the business and takes action across the customer journey: helping it get found, turning inquiries into customers, and bringing those customers back. It connects the tools owners already use and moves work forward, with owners choosing what to delegate and what to approve. Our foundation is Beside Phone. The phone is where our customers earn trust, understand what someone needs, and win business. Beside captures that context and connects it with email, calendars, websites, and the other tools the business runs on. That understanding lets the agent act on what matters. We believe AI should give people more freedom to build a business on their own terms. More time for the work they care about. More attention for the people they serve. More room for creativity, connection, and the work only they can do. That’s what we’re building. **The Role** ============ We're hiring a **Social Media Manager** to own Beside’s organic presence across our brand channels and selected founder accounts. You're a hands\-on, autonomous operator who knows what makes content work on social \- and turns raw material into a coherent, high\-quality presence. * **Own our social presence** * Own the social calendar, publishing, and day\-to\-day operation of our brand channels and selected founder accounts * Decide what’s worth publishing, where it belongs, and when it should go live * Keep a consistent cadence while leaving room for timely ideas and live opportunities * **Turn raw material into content that lands** * Find the strongest material across UGC, customer and team footage, product demos, and selected paid creative * Reframe, edit, package, and write each piece for the platform instead of reposting assets as\-is * Create lightweight original content independently when the calendar or an opportunity calls for it * **Give every account a clear voice** * Maintain a consistent Beside voice while adapting hooks, copy, formats, and cadence to each platform * Help selected founders turn their thinking and product moments into posts that feel like them * Build recognizable formats that make our product, customers, and team worth following * **Build a repeatable social engine** * Build a reliable workflow from raw input to finished post so strong content gets published quickly and consistently * Track performance and audience signals to understand what resonates * Turn those learnings into better creative decisions and a stronger content mix **Bonus signals** * You run your own YouTube channel and know what it takes to build content that lands * You've distributed to SMBs in the US and know how that audience thinks **How we think \& work** ======================== At Beside, we don’t just build products \- we redefine how humans interact with each other. We believe in extreme ownership, radical transparency, where every team member is empowered to think, build, and lead. We operate with a written\-first, and public\-first culture, ensuring that decisions are made with clarity, speed, and impact. This isn’t a rulebook \- it’s a manifesto for how we work, collaborate, and win. If you’re here, it means you’re ready to think like an owner, embrace ambiguity, and help shape the human\-machine interactions. **Distributed ownership** ------------------------- We don’t believe in hierarchy \- we believe in ownership. Strategic thinking, asking for help, and over\-communicating drive our collective success. **Why we operate this way** 01 **Decisions.** People closest to the problem are the owners. 02 **Growth.** Big ownership fuels responsibility, engagement, and impact. 03 **Care.** Owners care. From midnight bug fixes to spotting flaws for launch. **What this means day\-to\-day** 01 **Scope.** Everyone defines and evolves their mandate as the company grows. 02 **Coaching.** No managers or direct reports. Mentorship replaces hierarchy. 03 **Product.** Engineers own the full lifecycle: Scope Build Ship Measure. **Public\-first culture** ------------------------- Radical transparency isn’t optional \- it’s the operating system. When everything is accessible, we move faster, trust deeper, and execute harder. **Why we operate this way** 01 **Context.** Shared data means sharper decisions, faster. 02 **Focus.** Transparency removes politics and second\-guessing. 03 **Fairness.** Everyone sees the same raises, reviews, and decisions. **What this means day\-to\-day** 01 **Open.** No DMs; discussions and decisions happen in public channels. 02 **Visibility.** From co\-founders to newest hire: fundraising, board decks, metrics, compensation, reviews. 03 **Learning.** Documentation and open reflection turn mistakes into fuel. **Written\-first philosophy** ----------------------------- We default to writing, not meetings. In a global, remote team, writing keeps us aligned, accountable, and moving fast. **Why we operate this way** 01 **Clarity.** Writing forces precision and strategic thinking. 02 **Scale.** Written decisions compound and serve everyone, present or not. 03 **Efficiency.** Documentation prevents repetition and speeds onboarding. **What this means day\-to\-day** 01 **Decisions.** 95% made in writing, 100% documented. If it a decision wasn’t written, it didn’t happen. 02 **Tools.** The right medium for the right task. Syncs only when faster than writing. 03 **Async.** Global collaboration flows across time zones. **Location \& benefits** ------------------------ **Compensation:** $75,000\-$137,400 depending on seniority, plus generous stock options. **Location:** Remote\-friendly within the US. NYC is a strong plus (office based in Williamsburg). **Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, plus 401(k). **Perks:** Home office setup stipend and company offsites abroad several times per year. **Hiring Process** ------------------ We’ve designed our process to show you who we are \- and to discover how your talent could shape what we build next. 01 **Mission \& value deep dive** Deep dive into our mission, vision, and ways of working. Think of this as us pitching to you, like you were an investor. Ask all the questions you want \- we want you to leave with full clarity. If we move forward, you’ll also get access to try our products. 02 **Technical interview** Showcase your technical expertise and walk us through your background. This is a collaborative session \- bring your questions about our product and tech approach. 03 **Case study \& live review** Work through a case study, then review it live with us. We’ll focus on your decision\-making process, tradeoffs, and prioritization skills. Be prepared to explain your reasoning in depth. 04 **Behavioural interview** A conversation about how you collaborate, handle challenges, and approach growth. This is where we explore culture fit and how we can help you thrive. * **Join us** If you want to help redefine how humans communicate \- and you care deeply about supporting people with clarity and empathy \- we’d love to talk. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Great people grow fast at Beside.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - BQL Reliability Engineering
jobs.description: **What You’ll Do:** As part of the BQL (Bloomberg Query Language) Reliability Engineering team, you will build software and platform capabilities that improve the reliability, resilience, and transparency of BQL and the services it depends on. You’ll work on engineering problems at significant scale, using software and automation to make reliability a built\-in property of the platform rather than a purely operational concern. **You’ll be trusted to:** * Design, build, and maintain software and self\-service platform capabilities that enable engineering teams to understand, operate, and improve the reliability of BQL at scale. * Build tools and automated diagnostic capabilities that analyze telemetry and system behavior, helping engineers rapidly identify failures, regressions, and their root causes. * Develop software that improves incident detection and diagnosis, reducing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) for high\-severity incidents. * Engineer observability capabilities that turn metrics, logs, traces, and other system signals into actionable insights across BQL’s distributed architecture. * Partner with BQL engineering teams on system design, instrumentation, SLIs and SLOs, ensuring reliability is built into services throughout the Software Development Lifecycle. * Improve platform resilience through engineering and experimentation, including load and stress testing, canary releases, controlled experiments, and failure testing. * Identify recurring operational problems and eliminate them through software, automation, and improvements to platform architecture. **You’ll Need to Have:** * 4\+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related technical role. * Experience working with an object\-oriented programming language (C/C\+\+, Python, Java, etc.) * Strong knowledge of Linux/UNIX systems and experience developing or operating distributed applications in production. * Demonstrated experience improving the performance, availability, resilience, or scalability of mid\- to large\-scale systems. * Experience with production software delivery, including deployment, release management, testing, and safely introducing changes into distributed systems. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to use production data and system telemetry to understand complex system behavior.
