If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact our recruitment helpline at (775\) 784\-1495 or jobs@unr.edu . **Job Description** The University of Nevada, Reno (UNR) is seeking an Assistant Director, Corporate and Foundation Relations to support the Executive Director of Corporate and Foundation Relations in advancing a comprehensive corporate and foundation fundraising program. The position assists with the development and implementation of fundraising strategies, manages an assigned portfolio of corporate and foundation prospects, and coordinates proposal development, funder communications, and stewardship activities in support of the University’s colleges, academic priorities, research programs, and institutional initiatives. Serving as a key point of coordination between University Advancement and campus partners, the Assistant Director collaborates with faculty, deans, researchers, and Advancement colleagues to identify and cultivate funding opportunities, develop competitive proposals, and strengthen relationships with corporate and foundation partners. The position helps align external funding opportunities with University priorities and supports effective prospect management, solicitation, stewardship, and compliance activities.Reporting to the Executive Director of Corporate and Foundation Relations, the Assistant Director works collaboratively with Advancement staff and campus partners across the University to support the identification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship of corporate and foundation funding opportunities. **Required Qualifcations** Bachelor’s Degree and two (2\) years of related professional work experience **OR** Master’s Degree and one (1\) year of related professional work experience **Related Experience:** Experience supporting corporate and foundation fundraising activities, proposal development, and stewardship processes, preferably in higher education or a large nonprofit organization or related experience. **Schedule and Travel Requirements** Flexible work schedule, with travel and weekend work necessary **Compensation Grade** Administrative Faculty – C To view the salary schedule for this position, please visit: Salary Schedules and select Administrative Faculty by Grade. Salary is competitive and commensurate with related education and experience. **Remarkable Retirement** Our retirement plan is beyond compare. Your 19\.25% contribution is generously matched by the University. With the faculty retirement plan, you are 100% vested your first day. Sit back and watch your retirement dollars grow! All permanent employees on an annual "A" or "B" contract who are employed at least 50% full\-time are eligible to participate in the NSHE retirement program unless they are members of PERS of Nevada. **Perks of Working at UNR** * Health insurance options including dental and vision \- Health Insurance * Generous annual and sick leave and life insurance – Faculty Benefits * E. L. Wiegand Fitness Center offers annual or semester memberships and spouse/domestic partner membership options. E.L. Wiegand Fitness Center * Reno is proud to be a University town! Many local businesses offer discounts to WolfCard holders * Mountain EAP supports employees (and eligible dependents) through life's difficult moments. Mountain EAP is located in Reno and specializes in counseling and advising services for personal or interpersonal issues. * Faculty Senate is the principal representing body for faculty. Its membership includes representatives from each academic and administrative major unit of the University. Faculty Senate * No state income tax! **Grants\-in\-Aid for Faculty Employees** The University is proud to provide a reduced\-rate tuition benefit to faculty and qualified dependents. Faculty can take up to six credits per semester at a reduced rate. Dependents of faculty have unlimited credits, but in order to be eligible children must be unmarried and under the age of 24 and must receive at least 50% of their financial support from the employee and/or employee’s spouse or domestic partner. Faculty Grants\-in\-Aid **Faculty Dual Career Assistance Program** The University of Nevada, Reno recognizes the importance of addressing dual\-career couples’ professional needs. We offer a dual career assistance program to newly hired faculty spouses/partners that provides resources and assists them to identify career opportunities in Northern Nevada. Dual Career Assistance Program **Contact Information** Shane Karas at skaras@unr.edu **Exempt** Yes **Full\-Time Equivalent** 100\.0% **Required Attachment(s)** Please note, once you submit your application the only attachment/s viewable to you will be the attachment/s future powered by knowledge. Founded in 1874 as Nevada’s original land\-grant university, the University serves more than 23,000 undergraduate and graduate students from all 50 states and 63 countries. Classified by the Carnegie® Classification of Institutions of Higher Education as an R1 (“Very High Research”) university, it is also recognized in the Carnegie® Community Engagement classification. The University is also ranked by U.S. News \& World Report among the “Best National Universities” and “Best National Public Universities.” It also ranks in the top tier of the WSJ/Times Higher Education World University Rankings and the New York Times’ “Top Colleges for Economic Diversity.” Since 2009, nearly $1 billion has been has invested in advanced labs, facilities, and residence halls on the main campus. The University is home to Nevada’s first medical school – the University of Nevada, Reno School of Medicine and the Wayne L. Prim Campus at Lake Tahoe, where education, research, and creative work thrive in a stunning mountain setting. The University delivers on its original land\-grant mission with outreach across the state through the University of Nevada, Reno Extension, Nevada Agricultural Experiment Station, Nevada Bureau of Mines and Geology, Nevada Small Business Development Center, the Nevada Seismological Laboratory, and Wolf Pack Athletics. The main campus is in Reno, Nevada, a burgeoning global technology hub with a vibrant midtown and downtown. Found where the high desert of the Great Basin meets the High Sierra and Lake Tahoe, the beautiful, 290\-acre main campus is also a Nevada State Arboretum. The University’s physical infrastructure is expanding with ongoing construction of the newly named John Tullock Business Building, set to open in fall 2025\. Groundbreaking is also planned for a new State Public Health Laboratory Building on campus, alongside the recent acquisition of 16 parcels near campus, known as “University Village,” to provide affordable housing for graduate students and early career faculty. Collaborating with world\-renowned organizations, the University fosters innovation through initiatives such as the Digital Wolf Pack partnership with Apple, which ensures equitable access to technology for students, providing new incoming freshman or transfer students with an iPad Air and accessories. Google’s TechWise initiate is an 18\-month program that fully supports undergraduate students in becoming entry\-level software engineers by graduation. In 2023, the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Economic Development Administration (EDA) announced that Nevada – led by the University of Nevada, Reno – was named one of the inaugural 31 Regional Technology and Innovation Hubs (TechHubs). Nevada was selected from a competitive pool of 489 applicants from across the United States and its territories. Nevada’s Tech Hub will strengthen America’s lithium batteries, critical elements and other electric vehicle materials industry sectors within the state. Through its commitment to high\-impact education, world\-improving research and creative activity, and outreach that’s transforming Nevada’s communities and businesses, the University continues its 150\-year tradition of benefitting our state, nation and world. The University recognizes that diversity promotes excellence in education and research. The inclusive and engaged community on campus recognizes the added value that students, faculty, and staff from different backgrounds bring to the educational experience. Today, the University delivers on its original land\-grant mission of access to education and knowledge by investing in the academics, facilities, support, engagement and vibrant campus life that promote our diverse students’ cognitive growth and academic achievement – all while remaining one of the best values in American higher education. For more information, please visit the University’s website . **University of Nevada, Reno** ------------------------------

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Servicing
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we're united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that's both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We're proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn't mean distant. We're intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City (opening Summer 2026\), you'll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you're energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we'd love to hear from you. **The Team:** Upstart's **Servicing teams** play a critical role in supporting our borrowers throughout the life of their loan. They are responsible for helping ensure every borrower has a smooth, transparent, and empathetic experience—from the moment their loan is funded through final repayment. Servicing also plays an important role in Upstart's financial performance. By proactively preventing delinquency, managing operational costs, and continuously improving our servicing platform, they help protect both our borrowers and the business. This is where empathy meets execution—and where every interaction is an opportunity to build trust. As the **Senior Engineering Manager** at Upstart, you will lead a team of 12\+ engineers across two engineering squads, partnering closely with Product, Risk, and Operations to translate business needs into resilient, scalable technical solutions. This role reports to a Senior Director of Engineering and focuses on driving architectural clarity, developing high\-performing teams, and building systems that balance speed, reliability, and compliance. **How you'll make an impact** * Lead and develop multiple engineering teams responsible for critical Servicing products. * Define and execute multi\-quarter technical and engineering strategies aligned with Servicing and company priorities. * Partner with Product and cross\-functional leaders to translate borrower and business needs into scalable technical solutions. * Drive architectural clarity and justified technical decisioning across complex systems. * Build a culture of ownership, execution, collaboration, and operational excellence. * Hire, coach, and develop engineers and emerging engineering leaders * Establish clear visibility into technical priorities, delivery risks, trade\-offs, and roadmap execution. **Minimum Qualifications** * 10–15 years of software engineering experience, with 4–7 years in engineering management roles. * Deep technical expertise in distributed systems, APIs, and systems design. * Proven experience leading teams in regulated domains such as fintech, payments, or lending. * Demonstrated ability to define and deliver complex technical strategies that align with business goals. * Strong track record of building high\-performing teams and mentoring engineering leaders. * Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building technology in fintech, lending, payments, servicing, or another regulated environment. * 7\+ years of engineering management experience. * Experience leading both product and platform\-oriented engineering teams. * Strong product judgment and the ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes. * Experience modernizing or evolving complex technical platforms while continuing to deliver customer\-facing features. * Experience partnering closely with Product, Design, Operations, Risk, or other business functions. * Familiarity with applying AI or automation to customer experiences, internal workflows, or operational systems. **Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote **Time zone requirements** The team operates on the East/West coast time zones. **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in\-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in\-person sessions' cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2\-4 consecutive days at a time. \#LI\-REMOTE \#LI\-MidSenior **What you'll love** At Upstart, our benefits are designed to support your health, financial well\-being, family, and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City (opening Summer 2026!) For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices. *If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate\_accommodations@upstart.com* https://www.upstart.com/candidate\_privacy\_policy

jobs.title: IT Field Engineer I - Bemidji, MN
jobs.description: ### **Description** At VC3, we don’t just solve IT problems — we own them. We serve hundreds of municipalities and organizations across the United States and Canada, bringing IT to the people who need it most. We believe in earning trust, having a growth mindset, and delivering excellence every single time. We're a team of doers, builders, and tech whisperers who live by 4 core values: **Go Beyond** \| **Own It** \| **Be Curious**\| **Serve as One** We pride ourselves on making IT personal, making IT easy, and getting IT right. And it all starts with our talented team that is committed to raising the bar. **The Impact you will have:** In this role, you’ll provide hands\-on support at client sites, resolving technical issues across hardware, software and networks. You will ensure client success through timely resolution and consistent communication. You will understand and follow the VC3 Way, our set of standards and processes to ensure a predictable result for the customer.### **What you will be doing:** * Drive to client sites as scheduled while adhering to appointment schedules and promptly communicating any delays to the Service Coordinator * Install and set up new computer hardware, software and peripherals * Troubleshoot and resolve onsite issues related to workstations and printers * Collaborate with VC3 technical staff as onsite support for connectivity issues including ISPs, wireless networks, DHCP, DNS, and remote access technologies including VPN, RDS and Citrix * Educate and guide VC3 clients on technical standards and best practices * Identify recurring issues and initiate problem tickets for them * Make recommendations to the VC3 team for improvements of supported hardware and software * Maintain accurate and real time timesheets, record complete and accurate notes of troubleshooting and communication with clients * Additional duties as assigned ### **The tools you bring:** * Full\-time access to a vehicle, a valid driver's license, and no driving restrictions. Business class insurance for the vehicle if residing in Canada * 2 years of relevant technical experience OR 1 year experience in Service Technician I or II roles at VC3 * 2 years experience managing: Windows Client Operating Sytems (10,11\), Microsoft/Office 365, Virus and Security, TCP/IP, DHCP, and DNS * Go Beyond – you take that extra step to create moments that are unexpected but appreciated. * Own It \- You have the courage to do what's right, the resolve to take responsibility, and the grit to cross the finish line. * Be Curious \- You challenge the status quo and aim for continuous improvement and constant learning. * Serve as One \- You believe that together, we are greater than the sum of our individuals, and that teamwork is essential to success. ### **What’s in it for you:** * **Flexibility**– We’re remote\-first, but not remote\-only. Some roles include an onsite component, depending on team needs. We aim to give you the flexibility to do your best work, plus company\-paid time off to help you thrive in work and in life. * **Well\-being \& Support** \- Caring for our team goes beyond the workday. We offer a range of benefits to support your overall well\-being, from mental health and leave support through our Employee and Family Assistance Program, to financial wellness through company\-matched 401(k)/RRSP plans. Whether it’s today’s needs or tomorrow’s goals, we’ve got you covered. * **Grow with Us** – Whether you’re just getting started or ready to take the next step, we are committed to investing in your growth. We offer structured development through our Leadership Academy, monthly learning sessions, mentorship programs, learning reimbursements, internal career fairs, job shadowing, and personalized career\-pathing to support internal mobility. * **People\-First Culture** – We live our values, support each other, and create a space where everyone belongs. We have a common goal of doing work that matters, with autonomy, recognition, and a mission to serve those who serve. * **Transparent Leadership** – From open communication to clear company goals, our leaders are involved, and our managers are here to support your growth every step of the way. Applicant selected will be subject to a criminal and department of motor vehicles background checks and must meet Criminal Justice Information Systems (CJIS) requirements post\-employment **Thank you for your interest in VC3\. We appreciate all applications; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.** **Learn more about VC3 by visiting our website and follow us on LinkedIn to stay informed!** Want to know more about what it's like to be a Field Engineer? Take a look here!### **About VC3, Inc.** VC3 offers Managed IT Services, Private Cloud Services, Hosted VoIP, Custom Web Applications, SharePoint Consulting, and Website Design \& Hosting. VC3 has more than 25 years of experience providing a full range of Information Technology Solutions and Services to hundreds of municipalities and organizations throughout the United States and Canada. The technologies needed by our customers have changed many times over the years, but our focus has always stayed the same: connect the best technologies with our experienced and talented engineers, programmers, web designers and support specialists to deliver solutions that take our customers to the next level of productivity and results. We pride ourselves on making IT personal, making IT easy, and getting IT right. And it all starts with our talented team that is committed to raising the bar.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **Role: DevOps Engineer** **Location:** **1****st** **Preference \- Edina, MN (Hybrid 3 Days From Office)** **2****nd** **Preference Chicago (Illinois) / Irving (Texas) (Hybrid 3 Days From Office)** **Mandatory Skills** Azure Devops Plumini Python CI/CD AKS **Desired Skills** Databricks Postgress **Job Description** The Senior Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and operating the enterprise cloud platform that enables development, data, and AI teams to deliver solutions rapidly, securely, and reliably. This role focuses on platform engineering, DevOps automation, developer self\-service, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes operations, and cloud\-native architecture within Microsoft Azure. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with a platform mindset, creating reusable, automated capabilities that improve developer productivity, operational excellence, security, and governance. **Key Responsibilities** **Platform Engineering** Design and implement internal platform capabilities that enable self\-service deployment and management of cloud resources. Develop reusable platform patterns, templates, golden paths, and reference architectures. Partner with application, data, security, IAM, and SRE teams to standardize and automate platform services. Establish platform roadmaps that improve developer experience and accelerate delivery. **DevOps \& CI/CD** Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions. Implement deployment automation across development, test, staging, and production environments. Establish release management, branching strategies, artifact management, and deployment governance. Enable secure, credential\-free deployments using OIDC federation and managed identities. Measure and improve deployment frequency, lead time, and change success rates. **Cloud Infrastructure** Engineer and operate Azure platform services including: Virtual Networks Private Endpoints Azure DNS Key Vault Storage Accounts Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) API Management (APIM) Azure Front Door Design secure and scalable network architectures supporting enterprise workloads. **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi. Create reusable modules and deployment standards. Manage infrastructure lifecycle through source control and automated pipelines. Enforce configuration consistency across environments. **Kubernetes \& Container Platforms** Deploy and manage workloads running on AKS. Implement Kubernetes operational best practices including: o Scaling o Resiliency o Secrets management o Ingress Develop container deployment standards and operational runbooks. Troubleshoot and optimize cluster performance and reliability. **Developer Self\-Service** Build self\-service platform capabilities that reduce manual infrastructure provisioning. Provide standardized deployment templates and automation workflows. Improve developer onboarding and application delivery experiences. Integrate platform services into developer portals and workflow automation platforms. **Security \& Identity** Implement secure cloud architectures aligned with enterprise security policies. Integrate Azure services with Entra ID. Configure Managed Identities, OAuth/OIDC, service principals, and workload identity federation. Collaborate with IAM teams on authentication, authorization, and least\-privilege access models. Ensure compliance with organizational security and regulatory requirements. **Observability \& Reliability** Implement monitoring and observability using Dynatrace, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and related tools. Develop dashboards, s, and operational metrics. Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities. Partner with SRE teams to improve platform reliability and performance. **FinOps \& Governance** Support cloud governance initiatives. Implement tagging, chargeback, and cost allocation strategies. Identify optimization opportunities for cloud resources. Partner with FinOps teams on cloud consumption reporting and financial accountability. **Required Qualifications** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience. Min 7\+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or related disciplines. Min 5\+ years of experience with Microsoft Azure. Experience designing and implementing GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines. Strong Infrastructure as Code. Experience operating Kubernetes platforms, preferably AKS. Experience with container technologies including Docker. Strong scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, or Python. Experience supporting cloud security and identity solutions. Familiarity with networking, DNS, load balancing, and cloud connectivity architectures. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience building Internal Developer Platforms (IDP). Experience supporting data and analytics platforms such as: o Databricks o Postgres o Data Lake technologies o AI/ML platforms Experience in healthcare, regulated industries, or enterprise\-scale environments. Azure certifications such as: o Azure Solutions Architect Expert o Azure DevOps Engineer Expert o Azure Administrator Associate Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, or equivalent). VeeRteq Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Staff Software Development Engineer in Test
jobs.description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. $129,000\.00 \- $210,000\.00 ✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually ✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire ✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors. **Why Join Workiva** Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI\-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world. At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you. jobs.title: Steel Fabrication Purchasing Agent
jobs.description: We are looking for an experience purchasing agent to join our team, the exceptional candidate will manage purchase orders, monitor supplier performance, expedite critical materials, and collaborate with internal teams to ensure materials arrive on time and production stays on schedule. **Steel, and Metal Fabrication Experience!** THIS DESCRIPTION IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AS THE COMPANY DEEMS NECESSARY**.** **POSITION DESCRIPTION** **I. GENERAL INFORMATION:** Position Title**:\*** Purchasing Agent\* Department: Office Location: Pineville North Carolina **II. PRIMARY PURPOSE OF POSITION:** Works from requisitions, drawings, specifications and job cards. Purchase or approve all materials and supplies as needed for manufacturing parts and all other shop and office supplies, excluding capital equipment with proper cost and inventory controls. **III. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:** **\*Essential Functions** \* 1\) Locates sources of supply and check’s reliability of suppliers; obtains quotations and makes comparisons for best prices. \* 2\) Consults appropriate people/departments when substitutions may be advantageous or when problems arise. \* 3\) Controls material inventory; runs material shortage report. \* 4\) Responsible for fiscal year inventory. \* 5\) Purchases materials needed for jobs and stock. \* 6\) Expedites open P.O.'s when necessary. \* 7\) Works hard negotiating material pricing. \* 8\) Approves and codes all purchases; reviews all requisitions and all invoices. \* 9\) Computer literate. \*10\) Receives material. \*11\) Keeps O.T.D of vendors \& suppliers, and a daily material shortage report. **\***12\)Receives and keeps materials purchased in the system. **IV. REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS:** a**. Knowledge**: High school diploma or equivalent necessary; Business degree a plus. b**. Experience**: Minimum of two years in purchasing experience required, in the metal fabrication industry (or manufacturing as a minimum). Experience with inventory control and data entry experience required. c. **Skills/Aptitude**: Key\-boarding skills; customer\-oriented, assertive, organized, accurate, detailed\-oriented, flexible in making demands and establishing priorities; effective time management skills, team\-player/willing to do whatever is needed to help ensure smooth flow of office work process **V. WORKING CONDITIONS:** Office environment; possible overtime. Trips into the shop are necessary at times and safety protection will be required. Steel toe shoes, and other PPE. **VI. LEVEL**: Works under minimal supervision, exercises some degree of discretion and independent judgment. Works under the pressure of deadlines. **Skills for Qualifications:**  **Strong Negotiation Skills** They should be able to secure the best prices and terms without compromising on quality or timelines.  **Industry Knowledge** Familiarity with metal types, fabrication processes, and supplier capabilities is essential for making informed purchasing decisions.  **Attention to Detail** Precision matters—especially when ordering materials that must meet exact specifications.  **Analytical Thinking** A good purchaser can assess vendor performance, compare bids, and forecast material needs based on production schedules.  **Communication \& Collaboration** They’ll need to coordinate with engineers, production teams, and suppliers—so clear, proactive communication is a must.  **Integrity \& Accountability** Trustworthiness is vital when handling budgets, contracts, and supplier relationships.  **Adaptability** The metal fabrication industry can be fast\-paced and unpredictable. A strong purchaser stays calm under pressure and adjusts quickly to changes in demand or supply chain disruptions.  **Tech Savvy** Experience with procurement software, ERP systems, and digital inventory tools is a big plus. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Growth and Revenue
jobs.description: **About Suno** ============== We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). **About the Role** ================== We’re hiring an Engineering Manager to lead Suno’s Revenue Growth engineering team: a cross\-platform group of backend, web, iOS, and Android engineers who discover and deliver Suno’s highest\-leverage commercial opportunities. The team owns pricing and packaging, paywalls and offers, subscriber retention, experimentation infrastructure, and revenue\-driving UX improvements, partnering closely with product, data science and the commerce platform team. This is a high\-autonomy role that combines product, technical, and people leadership: you’ll stay close enough to the code to review decisions and multiply technical ownership across your team. Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/6u29t3orv1a3kSTv **What You’ll Do** ================== * Lead and grow a team of backend, web, iOS, and Android engineers building Suno’s revenue product roadmap * Set the revenue roadmap with product, data science, and other engineering teams, balancing fast experiments against bigger bets * Create the engineering plan for the next phase of the team: hiring, execution milestones, and operating cadence * Invest in the experimentation infrastructure and instrumentation the team runs on, so it can test more ideas and act on the results with confidence * Stay technically close enough to the work to understand system constraints and provide guidance on architecture * Test and spread AI\-enabled engineering workflows, and assess their impact on the team **What You’ll Need** ==================== **Must\-Haves** * Experience managing engineers (2\+ years), following deep experience as a full\-stack engineer * Product and commercial judgment: comfortable shaping ambiguous roadmaps and connecting user behavior to business outcomes * Experience running data\-driven experimentation: forming hypotheses, choosing metrics, and discerning the limits of what data can teach us * Hiring and org\-building ability: identifying, sourcing, assessing, and retaining talent * Cross\-functional leadership: understanding partner goals, debating ideas constructively, communicating effectively, and building trust * Genuine enthusiasm for Suno’s mission and the future of music **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Experience in consumer subscriptions, growth, fintech, payments, pricing \& packaging * Billing infrastructure experience with systems such as Stripe and RevenueCat **Perks \& Benefits for Full\-Time Employees** ============================================== * Company Equity Package * 401(k) with 3% Employer Match \& Roth 401(k) * Medical, Dental, \& Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA \& FSA options) * 11 Paid Holidays \+ Unlimited PTO \& Sick Time * 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave * Creative Education Stipend * Generous Commuter Allowance * In\-Office Lunch (5 days per week) **Additional Notes:** * Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. * This role requires working onsite at our NYC office. **Compensation:** * The annual salary range for this role is $277K \- $346K \+ target equity \+ benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k) Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. jobs.title: Process Technician
jobs.description: T1 Energy is bringing solar manufacturing back to the U.S. by building a domestic solar supply chain. Our mission is to invigorate America with scalable, reliable, and low\-cost energy. Our fully operational 5GW solar module facility in Wilmer, Texas, can manufacture more than 20,000 modules every 24 hours. By the time you finish reading this paragraph, we will have produced two solar panels that will power American homes and fuel domestic AI. We're focused on building advanced American manufacturing and we're passionate about engineering a better future filled with abundant energy. **The Role** T1 Energy is looking to hire a Process Technician I supports daily manufacturing operations by monitoring equipment and process conditions, performing routine inspections, identifying abnormalities, and assisting with troubleshooting activities. This role is responsible for following standard work, supporting quality and safety compliance, and contributing to a clean, organized, and stable manufacturing environment. Process Technician I is expected to develop a foundational understanding of process flow, defect awareness, Lean manufacturing principles, and basic continuous improvement practices. **What You’ll Do** * Conduct daily equipment and process inspections to ensure normal operation and promptly report abnormalities. * Support manufacturing processes by following standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and process standards. * Assist in troubleshooting basic equipment or process issues under the guidance of senior technicians, engineers, or supervisors. * Accurately complete production, quality, and maintenance\-related records. * Collect process and quality data as required and support data entry into MES or other tracking systems. * Support line changeovers, process checks, and routine operational verification activities. * Participate in process incident reviews and communicate abnormalities or recurring issues to leadership. * Maintain assigned work areas in accordance with 5S and workplace organization standards. * Support the development and sustainment of standardized work practices. * Participate in basic continuous improvement activities and support implementation of process changes. * Follow all environmental, health, and safety (EHS) requirements, including proper PPE and safe work practices. * Assist in training support activities as assigned. * Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned by management. **Who You Are** * Basic understanding of **Lean manufacturing concepts**, including: + 5S + waste identification + standard work * Ability to recognize process abnormalities and escalate appropriately. * Basic awareness of quality checkpoints, process controls, and defect prevention. * Willingness to learn troubleshooting, root cause thinking, and continuous improvement methods **Qualifications** * Technical diploma, certificate, or associate degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or related field preferred. * 0–2 years of experience in a manufacturing or technical environment preferred. * Basic understanding of manufacturing processes, equipment operation, or industrial production environments. * Ability to use hand tools, measuring instruments, and basic computer systems. * Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). * Good communication, reliability, and willingness to learn in a shift\-based environment **The T1 Way** We move fast, expect accountability, and treat people with respect. We also have a no\-jerks policy: we don't tolerate big egos, bad behavior or "that's not my job attitude". Be sharp, be honest, be human. If you can hold the line and have a sense of humor, you'll fit right in. T1 Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Optimizer
jobs.description: **Who we are** ============== School scheduling is a hard problem, one that technology was meant to solve. Yet for decades, the master schedule has been built by hand, consuming educators’ valuable time while delivering a sub\-optimal result for students. We started Timely to build the tool we wish we had when we were in schools. And today, we are changing how schools create high quality schedules for teachers and students. Timely combines groundbreaking AI technology with support from a team of expert school schedulers: saving schedulers’ time, and surfacing opportunities for leaders to unlock staff potential. Timely delivers optimized master schedules that are more efficient, accommodate diverse educator needs, and enable student access to courses and pathways that impact their lives. Our district and school partners agree: scheduling is a key opportunity for educational innovation, and that Timely is the indispensable partner in addressing the challenge. We’re experiencing exciting growth as a company, while doubling down on our mission and people\-centered approach to leveraging powerful technology. We serve districts and charter school organizations across 20\+ states, growing (and renewing) at rates that lead the education technology industry. This growth has been driven by our strong product\-market fit, deep understanding of education, and commitment to customer success. **About the Role** ================== We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who will design, build, and maintain our core optimization technology along with the full\-stack and data\-intensive systems surrounding it, powering scheduling for our users. You will be expected to lead challenging technical projects encompassing these technical domains. You will also be responsible for operationalizing the optimizer product for scale and usage: being on\-call as needed, establishing tests and observability, and running data\-driven experiments to inform decisions about the core technology. Finally, you’ll provide leadership within your squad and with the overall engineering team on critical engineering concerns that accelerate our ability to deliver value to customers at high quality and high scale. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Partner with product to surface and refine improvements in the optimizer’s core algorithm, model\-builders, and the full\-stack job orchestration framework built around it. * Research, recommend, and implement extensions to the core optimization technology: leveraging new technologies (including generative AI and machine learning) to improve accuracy, speed, and accessibility for users. * Lead major projects or initiatives as necessary while also supporting the product squad as a whole in meeting their goals. Drive the process of defining and disambiguating new opportunities when necessary. * Provide technical leadership over at least some key areas of the stack for the optimizer squad, along with the wider engineering team. * Exhibit and apply best practices around communication, collaboration, and project management to facilitate effective, timely, and high quality delivery of work. * Troubleshoot customer issues and provide timely resolutions to ensure a seamless scheduling experience. Some limited on\-call responsibilities may apply. * Mentor and support junior engineers, promoting a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * 4\+ years of development experience, with a demonstrated track record of shipping value to customers while contributing across the stack as necessary. * Prior success in driving software delivery on complex and challenging technology projects (partnering with product stakeholders, driving critical decisions, establishing project roadmaps and work tasks, presenting outcomes to external stakeholders, etc.). * Depth of knowledge in at least some of the following areas, with a strong interest and capacity to learn in the others: + Linear optimization modeling and solvers + Application stacks built heavily on machine learning + Product and infrastructure stacks leveraging generative AI + Backend API and asynchronous task development * An ability to dive into other critical parts of the stack when the product and team needs demand it, including: frontend engineering, cloud infrastructure, and data engineering. * Demonstrated record of diving deep into complex product requirements and challenging technical domains and learning and contributing to them quickly. * Proficiency in developing and maintaining scalable web applications, implementing unit and integration tests, and working with CI/CD pipelines. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, especially in cross\-functional environments. * Commitment to continuous improvement: seeking out and welcoming code reviews, pairing, and collaborative problem\-solving. * Experience and comfort operating in a fast startup environment and all that entails: strong sense of ownership, self\-direction, bias towards action, and optimizing for quick delivery of value and learnings for the business. * Prior experience in EdTech is a plus but not required. * Fully remote role with a preference for candidates based in NY or Boston. **Why Join Us** =============== * Work with an exceptional team tackling meaningful challenges in education. * Be part of a growing, financially healthy company with a proven product. * Enjoy comprehensive benefits, including health, dental, vision, and life insurance, unlimited PTO, and professional development opportunities including free access to online learning programs.
